title: The Book of Proverbs Decoded
author: Brittany Johnson
description: The Book of Proverbs — every verse decoded into plain, modern English (DMLV).

verses.kjv: The proverbs of Solomon the son of David, king of Israel;
verses.decoded: These are the wise sayings of Solomon, son of David, king of Israel.

verses.kjv: To know wisdom and instruction; to perceive the words of understanding;
verses.decoded: To learn wisdom and receive guidance; to understand meaningful words.

verses.kjv: To receive the instruction of wisdom, justice, and judgment, and equity;
verses.decoded: To accept teaching about wisdom, fairness, justice, and honesty.

verses.kjv: To give subtilty to the simple, to the young man knowledge and discretion.
verses.decoded: To help those who are inexperienced become wise, and to give young people good judgment and understanding.

verses.kjv: A wise man will hear, and will increase learning; and a man of understanding shall attain unto wise counsels:
verses.decoded: A wise person listens and learns more; someone with understanding gains good advice.

verses.kjv: To understand a proverb, and the interpretation; the words of the wise, and their dark sayings.
verses.decoded: To grasp the meaning of proverbs and their explanations, including the wise sayings and their deeper meanings.

verses.kjv: The fear of the LORD is the beginning of knowledge: but fools despise wisdom and instruction.
verses.decoded: Respecting the LORD is the foundation of true knowledge, but fools reject wisdom and guidance.

verses.kjv: My son, hear the instruction of thy father, and forsake not the law of thy mother:
verses.decoded: My child, listen to your father's teaching and don’t ignore your mother's guidance.

verses.kjv: For they shall be an ornament of grace unto thy head, and chains about thy neck.
verses.decoded: Their teachings will be like beautiful decorations on your head and necklaces around your neck.

verses.kjv: My son, if sinners entice thee, consent thou not.
verses.decoded: My child, if wrongdoers try to persuade you, don’t agree to join them.

verses.kjv: If they say, Come with us, let us lay wait for blood, let us lurk privily for the innocent without cause:
verses.decoded: If they say, ‘Come with us to ambush and harm innocent people without reason,’

verses.kjv: Let us swallow them up alive as the grave; and whole, as those that go down into the pit:
verses.decoded: Let’s trap them alive like the grave swallows people, like those who go down into the pit.

verses.kjv: We shall find all precious substance, we shall fill our houses with spoil:
verses.decoded: We will find valuable things and fill our homes with loot.

verses.kjv: Cast in thy lot among us; let us all have one purse:
verses.decoded: Join us and share in the same wealth.

verses.kjv: My son, walk not thou in the way with them; refrain thy foot from their path:
verses.decoded: My child, don’t follow their path; stay away from where they go.

verses.kjv: For their feet run to evil, and make haste to shed blood.
verses.decoded: Their actions quickly lead them to do evil and rush to commit murder.

verses.kjv: Surely in vain the net is spread in the sight of any bird.
verses.decoded: It is useless to set a trap where the birds can see it coming.

verses.kjv: And they lay wait for their own blood; they lurk privily for their own lives.
verses.decoded: In the end, they are setting traps that will harm themselves and threaten their own lives.

verses.kjv: So are the ways of every one that is greedy of gain; which taketh away the life of the owners thereof.
verses.decoded: This is how it goes for anyone who is greedy for money—it destroys their own life.

verses.kjv: Wisdom crieth without; she uttereth her voice in the streets:
verses.decoded: Wisdom calls out loudly in public places, making her voice heard in the streets.

verses.kjv: She crieth in the chief place of concourse, in the openings of the gates: in the city she uttereth her words, saying,
verses.decoded: She calls out in busy public squares and city gates, speaking her message clearly.

verses.kjv: How long, ye simple ones, will ye love simplicity? and the scorners delight in their scorning, and fools hate knowledge?
verses.decoded: How long will you naive people love being simple-minded? Scorners enjoy mocking, and fools hate learning.

verses.kjv: Turn you at my reproof: behold, I will pour out my spirit unto you, I will make known my words unto you.
verses.decoded: Change your ways when I correct you; I will share my spirit with you and reveal my teachings.

verses.kjv: Because I have called, and ye refused; I have stretched out my hand, and no man regarded;
verses.decoded: But you ignored my calls and refused to listen when I reached out to you.

verses.kjv: But ye have set at nought all my counsel, and would none of my reproof:
verses.decoded: You rejected all my advice and refused to accept my correction.

verses.kjv: I also will laugh at your calamity; I will mock when your fear cometh;
verses.decoded: So I will laugh at your troubles and mock you when fear overtakes you.

verses.kjv: When your fear cometh as desolation, and your destruction cometh as a whirlwind; when distress and anguish cometh upon you.
verses.decoded: When disaster strikes suddenly like a storm, bringing distress and suffering.

verses.kjv: Then shall they call upon me, but I will not answer; they shall seek me early, but they shall not find me:
verses.decoded: Then they will call to me, but I won’t answer; they will look for me early but won’t find me.

verses.kjv: For that they hated knowledge, and did not choose the fear of the LORD:
verses.decoded: Because they hated knowledge and refused to respect the LORD.

verses.kjv: They would none of my counsel: they despised all my reproof.
verses.decoded: They refused all my advice and rejected every correction I offered.

verses.kjv: Therefore shall they eat of the fruit of their own way, and be filled with their own devices.
verses.decoded: So they will experience the consequences of their own actions and be satisfied with the plans they have made.

verses.kjv: For the turning away of the simple shall slay them, and the prosperity of fools shall destroy them.
verses.decoded: Because ignoring wisdom will lead to the downfall of simple people, and the success of fools will ruin them.

verses.kjv: But whoso hearkeneth unto me shall dwell safely, and shall be quiet from fear of evil.
verses.decoded: But whoever listens to me will live safely and without fear of harm.

verses.kjv: My son, if thou wilt receive my words, and hide my commandments with thee;
verses.decoded: My child, if you are willing to listen to my advice and keep my instructions close to your heart;

verses.kjv: So that thou incline thine ear unto wisdom, and apply thine heart to understanding;
verses.decoded: If you pay attention to wisdom and focus your heart on gaining understanding;

verses.kjv: Yea, if thou criest after knowledge, and liftest up thy voice for understanding;
verses.decoded: If you earnestly ask for knowledge and raise your voice to seek understanding;

verses.kjv: If thou seekest her as silver, and searchest for her as for hid treasures;
verses.decoded: If you search for wisdom as eagerly as you would look for silver or hidden treasure;

verses.kjv: Then shalt thou understand the fear of the LORD, and find the knowledge of God.
verses.decoded: Then you will understand what it means to respect the LORD and gain true knowledge of God.

verses.kjv: For the LORD giveth wisdom: out of his mouth cometh knowledge and understanding.
verses.decoded: For the LORD gives wisdom; from His mouth come knowledge and understanding.

verses.kjv: He layeth up sound wisdom for the righteous: he is a buckler to them that walk uprightly.
verses.decoded: He stores up true wisdom for those who live right; He is a shield to those who live with integrity.

verses.kjv: He keepeth the paths of judgment, and preserveth the way of his saints.
verses.decoded: He protects the way of justice and watches over the path of His faithful followers.

verses.kjv: Then shalt thou understand righteousness, and judgment, and equity; yea, every good path.
verses.decoded: Then you will understand what is right, fair, and just, and you will recognize every good way to live.

verses.kjv: When wisdom entereth into thine heart, and knowledge is pleasant unto thy soul;
verses.decoded: When wisdom fills your heart and knowledge brings joy to your soul;

verses.kjv: Discretion shall preserve thee, understanding shall keep thee:
verses.decoded: Good judgment will protect you, and understanding will watch over you;

verses.kjv: To deliver thee from the way of the evil man, from the man that speaketh froward things;
verses.decoded: To rescue you from the path of evil people and from those who speak twisted or dishonest words;

verses.kjv: Who leave the paths of uprightness, to walk in the ways of darkness;
verses.decoded: People who abandon the right way and choose to follow dark and harmful paths;

verses.kjv: Who rejoice to do evil, and delight in the frowardness of the wicked;
verses.decoded: Who take pleasure in doing wrong and enjoy the perverseness of the wicked;

verses.kjv: Whose ways are crooked, and they froward in their paths:
verses.decoded: Their ways are twisted, and they are stubbornly wrong in their actions.

verses.kjv: To deliver thee from the strange woman, even from the stranger which flattereth with her words;
verses.decoded: To protect you from the foreign woman, the stranger who uses flattering words to deceive you;

verses.kjv: Which forsaketh the guide of her youth, and forgetteth the covenant of her God.
verses.decoded: She abandons the one who guided her when she was young and forgets the agreement she made with her God.

verses.kjv: For her house inclineth unto death, and her paths unto the dead.
verses.decoded: Her home leads to death, and her ways lead to the grave.

verses.kjv: None that go unto her return again, neither take they hold of the paths of life.
verses.decoded: Those who go to her do not come back or follow the path that leads to life.

verses.kjv: That thou mayest walk in the way of good men, and keep the paths of the righteous.
verses.decoded: So that you may live among good people and follow the ways of the righteous.

verses.kjv: For the upright shall dwell in the land, and the perfect shall remain in it.
verses.decoded: The honest will live in the land, and those who are blameless will stay there.

verses.kjv: But the wicked shall be cut off from the earth, and the transgressors shall be rooted out of it.
verses.decoded: But the wicked will be removed from the land, and sinners will be completely destroyed.

verses.kjv: My son, forget not my law; but let thine heart keep my commandments:
verses.decoded: My child, don’t forget my teachings; keep my instructions close to your heart.

verses.kjv: For length of days, and long life, and peace, shall they add to thee.
verses.decoded: Following them will bring you a long life, many years, and peace.

verses.kjv: Let not mercy and truth forsake thee: bind them about thy neck; write them upon the table of thine heart:
verses.decoded: Never let kindness and honesty leave you; keep them close like a necklace and engrave them deeply in your heart.

verses.kjv: So shalt thou find favour and good understanding in the sight of God and man.
verses.decoded: By doing this, you will gain favor and good judgment both with God and with people.

verses.kjv: Trust in the LORD with all thine heart; and lean not unto thine own understanding.
verses.decoded: Trust the LORD completely and don’t rely only on your own ideas.

verses.kjv: In all thy ways acknowledge him, and he shall direct thy paths.
verses.decoded: Include Him in everything you do, and He will guide your steps.

verses.kjv: Be not wise in thine own eyes: fear the LORD, and depart from evil.
verses.decoded: Don’t think you know it all; respect the LORD and turn away from evil.

verses.kjv: It shall be health to thy navel, and marrow to thy bones.
verses.decoded: This will bring healing to your body and strength to your bones.

verses.kjv: Honour the LORD with thy substance, and with the firstfruits of all thine increase:
verses.decoded: Honor the LORD with your wealth and give Him the first and best of everything you earn.

verses.kjv: So shall thy barns be filled with plenty, and thy presses shall burst out with new wine.
verses.decoded: Then your storage will be full, and your wine vats will overflow with new wine.

verses.kjv: My son, despise not the chastening of the LORD; neither be weary of his correction:
verses.decoded: My child, don’t reject the LORD’s discipline or get tired of His correction.

verses.kjv: For whom the LORD loveth he correcteth; even as a father the son in whom he delighteth.
verses.decoded: The LORD corrects those He loves, just like a father corrects the son he is proud of.

verses.kjv: Happy is the man that findeth wisdom, and the man that getteth understanding.
verses.decoded: Blessed is the person who finds wisdom and gains understanding.

verses.kjv: For the merchandise of it is better than the merchandise of silver, and the gain thereof than fine gold.
verses.decoded: Wisdom’s value is greater than silver, and its rewards are better than pure gold.

verses.kjv: She is more precious than rubies: and all the things thou canst desire are not to be compared unto her.
verses.decoded: Wisdom is more valuable than rubies, and nothing you desire compares to her.

verses.kjv: Length of days is in her right hand; and in her left hand riches and honour.
verses.decoded: Wisdom holds a long life in her right hand, and wealth and honor in her left.

verses.kjv: Her ways are ways of pleasantness, and all her paths are peace.
verses.decoded: Her ways are pleasant, and all her paths lead to peace.

verses.kjv: She is a tree of life to them that lay hold upon her: and happy is every one that retaineth her.
verses.decoded: Wisdom is like a life-giving tree to those who embrace her; everyone who holds on to her is happy.

verses.kjv: The LORD by wisdom hath founded the earth; by understanding hath he established the heavens.
verses.decoded: The LORD used wisdom to create the earth and understanding to set up the heavens.

verses.kjv: By his knowledge the depths are broken up, and the clouds drop down the dew.
verses.decoded: Through His knowledge, the seas were divided and the clouds release the dew.

verses.kjv: My son, let not them depart from thine eyes: keep sound wisdom and discretion:
verses.decoded: My child, always keep wisdom and good judgment in your sight.

verses.kjv: So shall they be life unto thy soul, and grace to thy neck.
verses.decoded: They will bring life to your soul and grace to your appearance.

verses.kjv: Then shalt thou walk in thy way safely, and thy foot shall not stumble.
verses.decoded: Then you will walk safely on your path and won’t trip or fall.

verses.kjv: When thou liest down, thou shalt not be afraid: yea, thou shalt lie down, and thy sleep shall be sweet.
verses.decoded: When you go to bed, you won’t be afraid; your sleep will be peaceful and sweet.

verses.kjv: Be not afraid of sudden fear, neither of the desolation of the wicked, when it cometh.
verses.decoded: Don’t be afraid of sudden dangers or the destruction caused by the wicked when it happens.

verses.kjv: For the LORD shall be thy confidence, and shall keep thy foot from being taken.
verses.decoded: The LORD will be your confidence and will keep you from falling.

verses.kjv: Withhold not good from them to whom it is due, when it is in the power of thine hand to do it.
verses.decoded: Don’t refuse to do good to those who deserve it when you have the ability to help.

verses.kjv: Say not unto thy neighbour, Go, and come again, and to morrow I will give; when thou hast it by thee.
verses.decoded: Don’t tell your neighbor to come back tomorrow when you already have what they need.

verses.kjv: Devise not evil against thy neighbour, seeing he dwelleth securely by thee.
verses.decoded: Don’t plan harm against your neighbor who lives peacefully near you.

verses.kjv: Strive not with a man without cause, if he have done thee no harm.
verses.decoded: Don’t argue or fight with someone who hasn’t wronged you.

verses.kjv: Envy thou not the oppressor, and choose none of his ways.
verses.decoded: Don't be jealous of those who do wrong, and don't follow their example.

verses.kjv: For the froward is abomination to the LORD: but his secret is with the righteous.
verses.decoded: The LORD hates those who are stubborn and perverse, but He shares His plans with those who are righteous.

verses.kjv: The curse of the LORD is in the house of the wicked: but he blesseth the habitation of the just.
verses.decoded: God’s curse rests on the home of the wicked, but He blesses the home of the righteous.

verses.kjv: Surely he scorneth the scorners: but he giveth grace unto the lowly.
verses.decoded: God mocks those who mock others, but He shows kindness to the humble.

verses.kjv: The wise shall inherit glory: but shame shall be the promotion of fools.
verses.decoded: Wise people will be honored, but fools will only gain shame.

verses.kjv: Hear, ye children, the instruction of a father, and attend to know understanding.
verses.decoded: Listen, children, to a father's teaching, and pay attention so you can gain understanding.

verses.kjv: For I give you good doctrine, forsake ye not my law.
verses.decoded: I am giving you good teaching; do not abandon my instructions.

verses.kjv: For I was my father’s son, tender and only beloved in the sight of my mother.
verses.decoded: I was my father's child, cherished and dearly loved by my mother.

verses.kjv: He taught me also, and said unto me, Let thine heart retain my words: keep my commandments, and live.
verses.decoded: He taught me and said, 'Keep my words in your heart; obey my commands and you will live.'

verses.kjv: Get wisdom, get understanding: forget it not; neither decline from the words of my mouth.
verses.decoded: Seek wisdom and understanding; don’t forget them or turn away from what I say.

verses.kjv: Forsake her not, and she shall preserve thee: love her, and she shall keep thee.
verses.decoded: Don’t abandon wisdom; she will protect you. Love her, and she will watch over you.

verses.kjv: Wisdom is the principal thing; therefore get wisdom: and with all thy getting get understanding.
verses.decoded: Wisdom is the most important thing; so get wisdom, and along with everything else, get understanding.

verses.kjv: Exalt her, and she shall promote thee: she shall bring thee to honour, when thou dost embrace her.
verses.decoded: Honor wisdom, and she will raise you up; she will bring you respect when you accept her.

verses.kjv: She shall give to thine head an ornament of grace: a crown of glory shall she deliver to thee.
verses.decoded: She will place a beautiful crown on your head; she will surround you with glory.

verses.kjv: Hear, O my son, and receive my sayings; and the years of thy life shall be many.
verses.decoded: Listen, my son, and accept what I say, and you will live a long life.

verses.kjv: I have taught thee in the way of wisdom; I have led thee in right paths.
verses.decoded: I have taught you the way of wisdom and guided you on the right path.

verses.kjv: When thou goest, thy steps shall not be straitened; and when thou runnest, thou shalt not stumble.
verses.decoded: When you walk, your steps won’t be restricted; when you run, you won’t trip.

verses.kjv: Take fast hold of instruction; let her not go: keep her; for she is thy life.
verses.decoded: Hold tightly to instruction; don’t let it go. Keep it close because it is your life.

verses.kjv: Enter not into the path of the wicked, and go not in the way of evil men.
verses.decoded: Don’t follow the path of the wicked or walk with evil people.

verses.kjv: Avoid it, pass not by it, turn from it, and pass away.
verses.decoded: Stay away from it; don’t even go near it. Turn away and keep going.

verses.kjv: For they sleep not, except they have done mischief; and their sleep is taken away, unless they cause some to fall.
verses.decoded: They don’t rest unless they have caused trouble, and they can’t sleep unless they have made someone stumble.

verses.kjv: For they eat the bread of wickedness, and drink the wine of violence.
verses.decoded: They live off evil deeds and indulge in acts of violence.

verses.kjv: But the path of the just is as the shining light, that shineth more and more unto the perfect day.
verses.decoded: But the way of the righteous is like bright light that keeps getting brighter until full daylight.

verses.kjv: The way of the wicked is as darkness: they know not at what they stumble.
verses.decoded: The way of the wicked is like darkness; they don’t see what causes them to fall.

verses.kjv: My son, attend to my words; incline thine ear unto my sayings.
verses.decoded: My child, listen carefully to what I say; pay close attention to my advice.

verses.kjv: Let them not depart from thine eyes; keep them in the midst of thine heart.
verses.decoded: Don’t let these words leave your sight; keep them deep in your heart.

verses.kjv: For they are life unto those that find them, and health to all their flesh.
verses.decoded: Because these words bring life to those who find them and healing to their whole body.

verses.kjv: Keep thy heart with all diligence; for out of it are the issues of life.
verses.decoded: Guard your heart carefully, because it controls everything you do.

verses.kjv: Put away from thee a froward mouth, and perverse lips put far from thee.
verses.decoded: Avoid a dishonest mouth and keep corrupt speech far from you.

verses.kjv: Let thine eyes look right on, and let thine eyelids look straight before thee.
verses.decoded: Keep your eyes focused straight ahead; look directly where you are going.

verses.kjv: Ponder the path of thy feet, and let all thy ways be established.
verses.decoded: Think carefully about the direction of your steps and make sure all your ways are firm.

verses.kjv: Turn not to the right hand nor to the left: remove thy foot from evil.
verses.decoded: Don’t turn to the right or left; stay away from evil.

verses.kjv: My son, attend unto my wisdom, and bow thine ear to my understanding:
verses.decoded: My son, listen carefully to my wisdom and pay close attention to my understanding.

verses.kjv: That thou mayest regard discretion, and that thy lips may keep knowledge.
verses.decoded: So that you may learn good judgment and keep knowledge in your speech.

verses.kjv: For the lips of a strange woman drop as an honeycomb, and her mouth is smoother than oil:
verses.decoded: The words of an adulterous woman are as sweet as honey, and her speech is smoother than oil.

verses.kjv: But her end is bitter as wormwood, sharp as a two-edged sword.
verses.decoded: But her outcome is bitter like wormwood and as sharp as a double-edged sword.

verses.kjv: Her feet go down to death; her steps take hold on hell.
verses.decoded: Her path leads to death, and her steps lead straight to the grave.

verses.kjv: Lest thou shouldest ponder the path of life, her ways are moveable, that thou canst not know them.
verses.decoded: So you won’t consider the way of life, because her paths are unstable and you cannot understand them.

verses.kjv: Hear me now therefore, O ye children, and depart not from the words of my mouth.
verses.decoded: Listen to me now, my children, and do not turn away from what I say.

verses.kjv: Remove thy way far from her, and come not nigh the door of her house:
verses.decoded: Stay far away from her and do not go near the entrance to her house.

verses.kjv: Lest thou give thine honour unto others, and thy years unto the cruel:
verses.decoded: So you won’t give your honor to others or your years to cruel people.

verses.kjv: Lest strangers be filled with thy wealth; and thy labours be in the house of a stranger;
verses.decoded: So that strangers don’t enjoy the results of your hard work and strength.

verses.kjv: And thou mourn at the last, when thy flesh and thy body are consumed,
verses.decoded: Then you will grieve in the end when your body wastes away.

verses.kjv: And say, How have I hated instruction, and my heart despised reproof;
verses.decoded: And say, ‘How I hated being taught and ignored correction!’

verses.kjv: And have not obeyed the voice of my teachers, nor inclined mine ear to them that instructed me!
verses.decoded: I did not listen to my teachers or pay attention to those who instructed me.

verses.kjv: I was almost in all evil in the midst of the congregation and assembly.
verses.decoded: I was nearly involved in every kind of wrongdoing among the people gathered here.

verses.kjv: Drink waters out of thine own cistern, and running waters out of thine own well.
verses.decoded: Be faithful to your own spouse and enjoy your own marriage.

verses.kjv: Let thy fountains be dispersed abroad, and rivers of waters in the streets.
verses.decoded: Let your sources of joy and satisfaction flow freely, like streams of water running through the streets.

verses.kjv: Let them be only thine own, and not strangers’ with thee.
verses.decoded: Let these blessings belong only to you and not to others.

verses.kjv: Let thy fountain be blessed: and rejoice with the wife of thy youth.
verses.decoded: May your source of life be blessed; be happy with the wife you had in your youth.

verses.kjv: Let her be as the loving hind and pleasant roe; let her breasts satisfy thee at all times; and be thou ravished always with her love.
verses.decoded: Let her be like a loving deer, graceful and delightful; may her love satisfy you always, and may you always be deeply captivated by her affection.

verses.kjv: And why wilt thou, my son, be ravished with a strange woman, and embrace the bosom of a stranger?
verses.decoded: So why, my son, would you be tempted by another woman and hold her close?

verses.kjv: For the ways of man are before the eyes of the LORD, and he pondereth all his goings.
verses.decoded: God watches all a person's actions and carefully considers every step they take.

verses.kjv: His own iniquities shall take the wicked himself, and he shall be holden with the cords of his sins.
verses.decoded: A wicked person is caught by their own wrongdoing and is trapped by the consequences of their sins.

verses.kjv: He shall die without instruction; and in the greatness of his folly he shall go astray.
verses.decoded: He will die without guidance, and because of his foolishness, he will lose his way.

verses.kjv: My son, if thou be surety for thy friend, if thou hast stricken thy hand with a stranger,
verses.decoded: My son, if you have promised to guarantee a friend's debt or made a commitment to someone you don't know well,

verses.kjv: Thou art snared with the words of thy mouth, thou art taken with the words of thy mouth.
verses.decoded: You are trapped by the promises you made with your own words; your own words have caught you.

verses.kjv: Do this now, my son, and deliver thyself, when thou art come into the hand of thy friend; go, humble thyself, and make sure thy friend.
verses.decoded: Now, my son, if you find yourself trapped by your friend’s claim, go quickly and humbly ask your friend to release you; try to win their favor.

verses.kjv: Give not sleep to thine eyes, nor slumber to thine eyelids.
verses.decoded: Don’t let yourself fall asleep or relax your guard.

verses.kjv: Deliver thyself as a roe from the hand of the hunter, and as a bird from the hand of the fowler.
verses.decoded: Escape like a deer from a hunter’s trap or like a bird from a birdcatcher’s snare.

verses.kjv: Go to the ant, thou sluggard; consider her ways, and be wise:
verses.decoded: Look at the ant, you lazy person; watch how she lives and learn wisdom.

verses.kjv: Which having no guide, overseer, or ruler,
verses.decoded: The ant has no leader, boss, or manager,

verses.kjv: Provideth her meat in the summer, and gathereth her food in the harvest.
verses.decoded: Yet it prepares its food during the summer and gathers supplies at harvest time.

verses.kjv: How long wilt thou sleep, O sluggard? when wilt thou arise out of thy sleep?
verses.decoded: How long will you keep sleeping, lazy person? When will you wake up from your laziness?

verses.kjv: Yet a little sleep, a little slumber, a little folding of the hands to sleep:
verses.decoded: Just a little more sleep, a little more rest, a little folding of the hands to relax,

verses.kjv: So shall thy poverty come as one that travelleth, and thy want as an armed man.
verses.decoded: And then poverty will come upon you suddenly, like a traveler, and lack will attack you like a warrior.

verses.kjv: A naughty person, a wicked man, walketh with a froward mouth.
verses.decoded: A wicked person behaves with a twisted, dishonest mouth.

verses.kjv: He winketh with his eyes, he speaketh with his feet, he teacheth with his fingers;
verses.decoded: He winks with his eyes, signals with his feet, and gestures with his fingers;

verses.kjv: Frowardness is in his heart, he deviseth mischief continually; he soweth discord.
verses.decoded: He has evil intentions in his heart, always planning trouble and causing arguments.

verses.kjv: Therefore shall his calamity come suddenly; suddenly shall he be broken without remedy.
verses.decoded: Because of this, disaster will strike him suddenly and he will be destroyed with no way to recover.

verses.kjv: These six things doth the LORD hate: yea, seven are an abomination unto him:
verses.decoded: There are six things the LORD hates, yes, seven things that are detestable to Him:

verses.kjv: A proud look, a lying tongue, and hands that shed innocent blood,
verses.decoded: Arrogant eyes, a lying tongue, and hands that kill innocent people,

verses.kjv: An heart that deviseth wicked imaginations, feet that be swift in running to mischief,
verses.decoded: A heart that plans evil schemes, and feet that are quick to rush into trouble,

verses.kjv: A false witness that speaketh lies, and he that soweth discord among brethren.
verses.decoded: A false witness who tells lies, and anyone who causes conflict among friends.

verses.kjv: My son, keep thy father’s commandment, and forsake not the law of thy mother:
verses.decoded: My son, obey your father's instructions and do not forget your mother's teachings.

verses.kjv: Bind them continually upon thine heart, and tie them about thy neck.
verses.decoded: Keep them always in your heart and wear them as a reminder around your neck.

verses.kjv: When thou goest, it shall lead thee; when thou sleepest, it shall keep thee; and when thou awakest, it shall talk with thee.
verses.decoded: They will guide you when you go, protect you while you sleep, and speak to you when you wake.

verses.kjv: For the commandment is a lamp; and the law is light; and reproofs of instruction are the way of life:
verses.decoded: For commandments are like a lamp, the law is like light, and correction and instruction lead to life.

verses.kjv: To keep thee from the evil woman, from the flattery of the tongue of a strange woman.
verses.decoded: They will protect you from the evil woman and from the flattering words of a stranger.

verses.kjv: Lust not after her beauty in thine heart; neither let her take thee with her eyelids.
verses.decoded: Do not desire her beauty in your heart, and do not let her charm you with her eyes.

verses.kjv: For by means of a whorish woman a man is brought to a piece of bread: and the adulteress will hunt for the precious life.
verses.decoded: A man is ruined by an immoral woman, ending up with nothing; an adulteress threatens a man's very life.

verses.kjv: Can a man take fire in his bosom, and his clothes not be burned?
verses.decoded: Can a man hold fire close to his chest without his clothes catching on fire?

verses.kjv: Can one go upon hot coals, and his feet not be burned?
verses.decoded: Can someone walk on hot coals without burning their feet?

verses.kjv: So he that goeth in to his neighbour’s wife; whosoever toucheth her shall not be innocent.
verses.decoded: In the same way, anyone who sleeps with another man's wife will not go unpunished.

verses.kjv: Men do not despise a thief, if he steal to satisfy his soul when he is hungry;
verses.decoded: People usually don’t hate a thief who steals just to satisfy his hunger;

verses.kjv: But if he be found, he shall restore sevenfold; he shall give all the substance of his house.
verses.decoded: But if he is caught, he must pay back seven times what he took, giving everything he owns.

verses.kjv: But whoso committeth adultery with a woman lacketh understanding: he that doeth it destroyeth his own soul.
verses.decoded: Anyone who commits adultery shows a lack of wisdom; by doing so, he harms himself deeply.

verses.kjv: A wound and dishonour shall he get; and his reproach shall not be wiped away.
verses.decoded: He will suffer injury and shame, and his disgrace will not be forgotten.

verses.kjv: For jealousy is the rage of a man: therefore he will not spare in the day of vengeance.
verses.decoded: Jealousy makes a man furious; on the day he seeks revenge, he will show no mercy.

verses.kjv: He will not regard any ransom; neither will he rest content, though thou givest many gifts.
verses.decoded: He won’t accept any payment to forgive, nor will he be satisfied even if you offer many gifts.

verses.kjv: My son, keep my words, and lay up my commandments with thee.
verses.decoded: My son, pay attention to what I say and keep my instructions close to you.

verses.kjv: Keep my commandments, and live; and my law as the apple of thine eye.
verses.decoded: Follow my commands and you will live; protect my teachings as carefully as you protect your own eyesight.

verses.kjv: Bind them upon thy fingers, write them upon the table of thine heart.
verses.decoded: Tie them to your fingers as a reminder, and engrave them deeply in your heart.

verses.kjv: Say unto wisdom, Thou art my sister; and call understanding thy kinswoman:
verses.decoded: Treat wisdom like a sister and understanding like a close relative.

verses.kjv: That they may keep thee from the strange woman, from the stranger which flattereth with her words.
verses.decoded: So they will protect you from the immoral woman, from the outsider who uses flattering words.

verses.kjv: For at the window of my house I looked through my casement,
verses.decoded: I looked out the window of my house,

verses.kjv: And beheld among the simple ones, I discerned among the youths, a young man void of understanding,
verses.decoded: and saw among the naive young men a boy who lacked sense,

verses.kjv: Passing through the street near her corner; and he went the way to her house,
verses.decoded: walking down the street near her house, heading toward her home,

verses.kjv: In the twilight, in the evening, in the black and dark night:
verses.decoded: at dusk, in the evening, during the dark night,

verses.kjv: And, behold, there met him a woman with the attire of an harlot, and subtil of heart.
verses.decoded: when suddenly a woman dressed like a prostitute, cunning and sly, met him.

verses.kjv: (She is loud and stubborn; her feet abide not in her house:
verses.decoded: She is loud and defiant; she doesn’t stay home,

verses.kjv: Now is she without, now in the streets, and lieth in wait at every corner.)
verses.decoded: but wanders the streets and waits at every corner.

verses.kjv: So she caught him, and kissed him, and with an impudent face said unto him,
verses.decoded: She grabbed him, kissed him boldly, and said to him with confidence,

verses.kjv: I have peace offerings with me; this day have I payed my vows.
verses.decoded: “I have brought peace offerings today; I have fulfilled my vows.

verses.kjv: Therefore came I forth to meet thee, diligently to seek thy face, and I have found thee.
verses.decoded: That’s why I came out to find you, looking carefully for you, and now I have found you.”

verses.kjv: I have decked my bed with coverings of tapestry, with carved works, with fine linen of Egypt.
verses.decoded: I have decorated my bed with rich tapestries, carved designs, and fine Egyptian linen.

verses.kjv: I have perfumed my bed with myrrh, aloes, and cinnamon.
verses.decoded: I have scented my bed with myrrh, aloes, and cinnamon.

verses.kjv: Come, let us take our fill of love until the morning: let us solace ourselves with loves.
verses.decoded: Come, let’s enjoy love until morning; let’s comfort ourselves with passion.

verses.kjv: For the goodman is not at home, he is gone a long journey:
verses.decoded: The husband is not at home; he has gone on a long trip.

verses.kjv: He hath taken a bag of money with him, and will come home at the day appointed.
verses.decoded: He took money with him and will return on a certain day.

verses.kjv: With her much fair speech she caused him to yield, with the flattering of her lips she forced him.
verses.decoded: With her smooth talk and flattering words, she persuaded him to give in.

verses.kjv: He goeth after her straightway, as an ox goeth to the slaughter, or as a fool to the correction of the stocks;
verses.decoded: He follows her immediately, like an ox heading to slaughter or a fool going to punishment.

verses.kjv: Till a dart strike through his liver; as a bird hasteth to the snare, and knoweth not that it is for his life.
verses.decoded: Until a sharp arrow pierces his liver; like a bird rushing into a trap, not realizing it means death.

verses.kjv: Hearken unto me now therefore, O ye children, and attend to the words of my mouth.
verses.decoded: Listen to me now, my children, and pay attention to what I say.

verses.kjv: Let not thine heart decline to her ways, go not astray in her paths.
verses.decoded: Don’t let your heart be led astray by her ways; don’t follow her paths.

verses.kjv: For she hath cast down many wounded: yea, many strong men have been slain by her.
verses.decoded: She has caused many to fall wounded; even strong men have been destroyed by her.

verses.kjv: Her house is the way to hell, going down to the chambers of death.
verses.decoded: Her house leads to death and destruction, like a path to the grave.

verses.kjv: Doth not wisdom cry? and understanding put forth her voice?
verses.decoded: Doesn't wisdom call out? Doesn't understanding raise her voice?

verses.kjv: She standeth in the top of high places, by the way in the places of the paths.
verses.decoded: She stands on the highest points, beside the roads and at the crossroads.

verses.kjv: She crieth at the gates, at the entry of the city, at the coming in at the doors.
verses.decoded: She shouts at the city gates, at the entrances, and at the doorways.

verses.kjv: Unto you, O men, I call; and my voice is to the sons of man.
verses.decoded: I call out to you, people; my voice is for all human beings.

verses.kjv: O ye simple, understand wisdom: and, ye fools, be ye of an understanding heart.
verses.decoded: You who are naive, learn wisdom; and you fools, develop understanding.

verses.kjv: Hear; for I will speak of excellent things; and the opening of my lips shall be right things.
verses.decoded: Listen carefully, because I will speak important truths; what I say will be right.

verses.kjv: For my mouth shall speak truth; and wickedness is an abomination to my lips.
verses.decoded: I will speak only truth; I hate wickedness and refuse to speak it.

verses.kjv: All the words of my mouth are in righteousness; there is nothing froward or perverse in them.
verses.decoded: Everything I say is fair and right; there is nothing twisted or dishonest in my words.

verses.kjv: They are all plain to him that understandeth, and right to them that find knowledge.
verses.decoded: My words are clear to those who understand and correct to those who gain knowledge.

verses.kjv: Receive my instruction, and not silver; and knowledge rather than choice gold.
verses.decoded: Accept my teaching instead of silver, and choose knowledge over the finest gold.

verses.kjv: For wisdom is better than rubies; and all the things that may be desired are not to be compared to it.
verses.decoded: Wisdom is more precious than rubies, and nothing you desire compares to it.

verses.kjv: I wisdom dwell with prudence, and find out knowledge of witty inventions.
verses.decoded: I, wisdom, live with prudence and discover clever plans.

verses.kjv: The fear of the LORD is to hate evil: pride, and arrogancy, and the evil way, and the froward mouth, do I hate.
verses.decoded: Respecting the LORD means hating evil; I hate pride, arrogance, wicked ways, and dishonest speech.

verses.kjv: Counsel is mine, and sound wisdom: I am understanding; I have strength.
verses.decoded: I provide wise advice and sound judgment; I am understanding and powerful.

verses.kjv: By me kings reign, and princes decree justice.
verses.decoded: Through me, kings rule and leaders make fair decisions.

verses.kjv: By me princes rule, and nobles, even all the judges of the earth.
verses.decoded: Through me, kings and rulers govern, even all the judges of the earth.

verses.kjv: I love them that love me; and those that seek me early shall find me.
verses.decoded: I love those who love me, and those who look for me sincerely will find me.

verses.kjv: Riches and honour are with me; yea, durable riches and righteousness.
verses.decoded: I have wealth and honor, lasting riches and righteousness.

verses.kjv: My fruit is better than gold, yea, than fine gold; and my revenue than choice silver.
verses.decoded: What I produce is better than gold, even the finest gold; my rewards are better than the best silver.

verses.kjv: I lead in the way of righteousness, in the midst of the paths of judgment:
verses.decoded: I guide people along the path of what is right and just.

verses.kjv: That I may cause those that love me to inherit substance; and I will fill their treasures.
verses.decoded: So that those who love me will receive wealth and I will fill their stores.

verses.kjv: The LORD possessed me in the beginning of his way, before his works of old.
verses.decoded: The LORD created me at the very start, before he made anything else.

verses.kjv: I was set up from everlasting, from the beginning, or ever the earth was.
verses.decoded: I was established long ago, from the very beginning, before the earth existed.

verses.kjv: When there were no depths, I was brought forth; when there were no fountains abounding with water.
verses.decoded: Before there were oceans or springs full of water, I was brought forth.

verses.kjv: Before the mountains were settled, before the hills was I brought forth:
verses.decoded: Before the mountains were formed and the hills were made, I was brought forth.

verses.kjv: While as yet he had not made the earth, nor the fields, nor the highest part of the dust of the world.
verses.decoded: Before he made the earth, the open land, or the highest parts of the dust of the world.

verses.kjv: When he prepared the heavens, I was there: when he set a compass upon the face of the depth:
verses.decoded: When he made the heavens, I was there; when he marked out the horizon over the surface of the deep.

verses.kjv: When he established the clouds above: when he strengthened the fountains of the deep:
verses.decoded: When he fixed the clouds above and made the springs of the deep strong,

verses.kjv: When he gave to the sea his decree, that the waters should not pass his commandment: when he appointed the foundations of the earth:
verses.decoded: When he gave the sea its limits so the waters would not cross his command, and when he set the earth’s foundations,

verses.kjv: Then I was by him, as one brought up with him: and I was daily his delight, rejoicing always before him;
verses.decoded: I was there with him like a child, and I was his delight, always rejoicing in his presence.

verses.kjv: Rejoicing in the habitable part of his earth; and my delights were with the sons of men.
verses.decoded: I was joyful over the part of the earth where people live, and I took pleasure in being with humanity.

verses.kjv: Now therefore hearken unto me, O ye children: for blessed are they that keep my ways.
verses.decoded: So listen to me, my children, because those who follow my teachings are truly blessed.

verses.kjv: Hear instruction, and be wise, and refuse it not.
verses.decoded: Pay attention to guidance and become wise; don’t reject it.

verses.kjv: Blessed is the man that heareth me, watching daily at my gates, waiting at the posts of my doors.
verses.decoded: Happy is the person who listens to me, eagerly waiting every day to learn from me.

verses.kjv: For whoso findeth me findeth life, and shall obtain favour of the LORD.
verses.decoded: Whoever finds me finds true life and receives the Lord’s approval.

verses.kjv: But he that sinneth against me wrongeth his own soul: all they that hate me love death.
verses.decoded: But anyone who rejects me harms themselves; those who hate me choose death.

verses.kjv: Wisdom hath builded her house, she hath hewn out her seven pillars:
verses.decoded: Wisdom has built her house and set up seven strong pillars.

verses.kjv: She hath killed her beasts; she hath mingled her wine; she hath also furnished her table.
verses.decoded: She has prepared a feast, mixed her wine, and set her table.

verses.kjv: She hath sent forth her maidens: she crieth upon the highest places of the city,
verses.decoded: She sends out her servants and calls out loudly from the city’s highest points,

verses.kjv: Whoso is simple, let him turn in hither: as for him that wanteth understanding, she saith to him,
verses.decoded: Calling to those who are naive or lack understanding, she says,

verses.kjv: Come, eat of my bread, and drink of the wine which I have mingled.
verses.decoded: Come and eat my bread and drink the wine I have prepared.

verses.kjv: Forsake the foolish, and live; and go in the way of understanding.
verses.decoded: Turn away from foolishness and live; follow the path of understanding.

verses.kjv: He that reproveth a scorner getteth to himself shame: and he that rebuketh a wicked man getteth himself a blot.
verses.decoded: If you correct a mocker, you’ll only bring shame on yourself; if you rebuke a wicked person, you’ll get a bad reputation.

verses.kjv: Reprove not a scorner, lest he hate thee: rebuke a wise man, and he will love thee.
verses.decoded: Don’t correct a mocker or they will hate you; but if you correct a wise person, they will appreciate it.

verses.kjv: Give instruction to a wise man, and he will be yet wiser: teach a just man, and he will increase in learning.
verses.decoded: Teach a wise person and they will become even wiser; instruct a righteous person and they will learn more.

verses.kjv: The fear of the LORD is the beginning of wisdom: and the knowledge of the holy is understanding.
verses.decoded: Respecting the LORD is the start of wisdom; understanding comes from knowing the holy one.

verses.kjv: For by me thy days shall be multiplied, and the years of thy life shall be increased.
verses.decoded: Because of me, your life will be longer and your years will increase.

verses.kjv: If thou be wise, thou shalt be wise for thyself: but if thou scornest, thou alone shalt bear it.
verses.decoded: If you are wise, it benefits you; but if you mock, you alone will suffer the consequences.

verses.kjv: A foolish woman is clamorous: she is simple, and knoweth nothing.
verses.decoded: A foolish woman is loud and ignorant; she doesn’t understand anything.

verses.kjv: For she sitteth at the door of her house, on a seat in the high places of the city,
verses.decoded: She sits at the entrance of her house, on a seat overlooking the city’s busiest places,

verses.kjv: To call passengers who go right on their ways:
verses.decoded: Calling out to people who are going straight on their way,

verses.kjv: Whoso is simple, let him turn in hither: and as for him that wanteth understanding, she saith to him,
verses.decoded: If you are naive, come here; and if you lack understanding, she says to you,

verses.kjv: Stolen waters are sweet, and bread eaten in secret is pleasant.
verses.decoded: Stolen water tastes sweet, and eating bread in secret feels exciting.

verses.kjv: But he knoweth not that the dead are there; and that her guests are in the depths of hell.
verses.decoded: But he does not realize that the dead are there, and that her guests are in the depths of the grave.

verses.kjv: The proverbs of Solomon. A wise son maketh a glad father: but a foolish son is the heaviness of his mother.
verses.decoded: A wise son brings joy to his father, but a foolish son brings sadness to his mother.

verses.kjv: Treasures of wickedness profit nothing: but righteousness delivereth from death.
verses.decoded: Wealth gained through wickedness is worthless, but living right saves you from death.

verses.kjv: The LORD will not suffer the soul of the righteous to famish: but he casteth away the substance of the wicked.
verses.decoded: God will not let the righteous go hungry, but he causes the wealth of the wicked to disappear.

verses.kjv: He becometh poor that dealeth with a slack hand: but the hand of the diligent maketh rich.
verses.decoded: Those who are lazy become poor, but hard work leads to wealth.

verses.kjv: He that gathereth in summer is a wise son: but he that sleepeth in harvest is a son that causeth shame.
verses.decoded: A wise son works hard during the harvest, but a lazy son brings shame by sleeping instead.

verses.kjv: Blessings are upon the head of the just: but violence covereth the mouth of the wicked.
verses.decoded: Blessings rest on the righteous, but violence silences the wicked.

verses.kjv: The memory of the just is blessed: but the name of the wicked shall rot.
verses.decoded: The righteous are remembered with honor, but the wicked are forgotten and despised.

verses.kjv: The wise in heart will receive commandments: but a prating fool shall fall.
verses.decoded: Those with wisdom accept instruction, but a foolish talker will suffer defeat.

verses.kjv: He that walketh uprightly walketh surely: but he that perverteth his ways shall be known.
verses.decoded: Those who live honestly walk safely, but those who twist their ways will be exposed.

verses.kjv: He that winketh with the eye causeth sorrow: but a prating fool shall fall.
verses.decoded: A deceitful wink causes trouble, but a foolish talker will come to ruin.

verses.kjv: The mouth of a righteous man is a well of life: but violence covereth the mouth of the wicked.
verses.decoded: The words of a righteous person bring life, but violence silences the wicked.

verses.kjv: Hatred stirreth up strifes: but love covereth all sins.
verses.decoded: Hatred causes fights, but love forgives and overlooks all wrongs.

verses.kjv: In the lips of him that hath understanding wisdom is found: but a rod is for the back of him that is void of understanding.
verses.decoded: A person with understanding speaks wisely, but a fool needs discipline.

verses.kjv: Wise men lay up knowledge: but the mouth of the foolish is near destruction.
verses.decoded: Wise people store up knowledge, but foolish talk leads to ruin.

verses.kjv: The rich man’s wealth is his strong city: the destruction of the poor is their poverty.
verses.decoded: A rich person’s wealth is like a strong fortress, but poverty is the downfall of the poor.

verses.kjv: The labour of the righteous tendeth to life: the fruit of the wicked to sin.
verses.decoded: The hard work of good people leads to life, but the results of the wicked lead to sin.

verses.kjv: He is in the way of life that keepeth instruction: but he that refuseth reproof erreth.
verses.decoded: Those who follow guidance are on the path to life, but those who reject correction go astray.

verses.kjv: He that hideth hatred with lying lips, and he that uttereth a slander, is a fool.
verses.decoded: Anyone who hides hatred behind lies or spreads slander is a fool.

verses.kjv: In the multitude of words there wanteth not sin: but he that refraineth his lips is wise.
verses.decoded: Talking too much often leads to sin, but those who control their speech are wise.

verses.kjv: The tongue of the just is as choice silver: the heart of the wicked is little worth.
verses.decoded: The words of a righteous person are like precious silver, but the heart of the wicked is worthless.

verses.kjv: The lips of the righteous feed many: but fools die for want of wisdom.
verses.decoded: The words of the righteous provide guidance to many, but fools die because they lack wisdom.

verses.kjv: The blessing of the LORD, it maketh rich, and he addeth no sorrow with it.
verses.decoded: God’s blessing brings wealth without trouble or grief.

verses.kjv: It is as sport to a fool to do mischief: but a man of understanding hath wisdom.
verses.decoded: Fools enjoy causing trouble, but wise people seek understanding.

verses.kjv: The fear of the wicked, it shall come upon him: but the desire of the righteous shall be granted.
verses.decoded: The fears of the wicked will come true, but the wishes of the righteous will be fulfilled.

verses.kjv: As the whirlwind passeth, so is the wicked no more: but the righteous is an everlasting foundation.
verses.decoded: Like a storm that passes away, the wicked will disappear, but the righteous stand firm forever.

verses.kjv: As vinegar to the teeth, and as smoke to the eyes, so is the sluggard to them that send him.
verses.decoded: A lazy person is as unpleasant to those who send him as vinegar is to teeth and smoke to eyes.

verses.kjv: The fear of the LORD prolongeth days: but the years of the wicked shall be shortened.
verses.decoded: Respecting God adds years to life, but the wicked will have their lives cut short.

verses.kjv: The hope of the righteous shall be gladness: but the expectation of the wicked shall perish.
verses.decoded: The righteous will be joyful in their hope, but the hopes of the wicked will be destroyed.

verses.kjv: The way of the LORD is strength to the upright: but destruction shall be to the workers of iniquity.
verses.decoded: God’s path gives strength to honest people, but those who do wrong will face ruin.

verses.kjv: The righteous shall never be removed: but the wicked shall not inhabit the earth.
verses.decoded: The righteous will remain secure forever, but the wicked will not live on the earth.

verses.kjv: The mouth of the just bringeth forth wisdom: but the froward tongue shall be cut out.
verses.decoded: A righteous person's words are full of wisdom, but a twisted or dishonest tongue will be silenced.

verses.kjv: The lips of the righteous know what is acceptable: but the mouth of the wicked speaketh frowardness.
verses.decoded: Righteous people speak what is right and acceptable, but the wicked speak things that are twisted and harmful.

verses.kjv: A false balance is abomination to the LORD: but a just weight is his delight.
verses.decoded: Dishonest scales are detestable to the Lord, but accurate weights please Him.

verses.kjv: When pride cometh, then cometh shame: but with the lowly is wisdom.
verses.decoded: Pride leads to disgrace, but those who are humble gain wisdom.

verses.kjv: The integrity of the upright shall guide them: but the perverseness of transgressors shall destroy them.
verses.decoded: Honest people are guided by their integrity, but those who are crooked will be ruined by their own actions.

verses.kjv: Riches profit not in the day of wrath: but righteousness delivereth from death.
verses.decoded: Wealth won’t help on the day of judgment, but living right will save you from death.

verses.kjv: The righteousness of the perfect shall direct his way: but the wicked shall fall by his own wickedness.
verses.decoded: The good person’s righteousness will guide their path, but the wicked will be destroyed by their own evil.

verses.kjv: The righteousness of the upright shall deliver them: but transgressors shall be taken in their own naughtiness.
verses.decoded: Good people are saved by their righteousness, but sinners are trapped by their own wrongdoing.

verses.kjv: When a wicked man dieth, his expectation shall perish: and the hope of unjust men perisheth.
verses.decoded: When a wicked person dies, their hopes die with them; the expectations of the unjust come to nothing.

verses.kjv: The righteous is delivered out of trouble, and the wicked cometh in his stead.
verses.decoded: The righteous escape trouble, but the wicked take their place and suffer instead.

verses.kjv: An hypocrite with his mouth destroyeth his neighbour: but through knowledge shall the just be delivered.
verses.decoded: A hypocrite’s words can harm others, but those who are wise are saved by understanding.

verses.kjv: When it goeth well with the righteous, the city rejoiceth: and when the wicked perish, there is shouting.
verses.decoded: When good people succeed, the whole community celebrates; when the wicked are destroyed, there is joy.

verses.kjv: By the blessing of the upright the city is exalted: but it is overthrown by the mouth of the wicked.
verses.decoded: The city prospers because of the blessings of good people, but it is ruined by the words of the wicked.

verses.kjv: He that is void of wisdom despiseth his neighbour: but a man of understanding holdeth his peace.
verses.decoded: A foolish person looks down on others, but a wise person stays quiet and listens.

verses.kjv: A talebearer revealeth secrets: but he that is of a faithful spirit concealeth the matter.
verses.decoded: A gossip spreads secrets, but a trustworthy person keeps them safe.

verses.kjv: Where no counsel is, the people fall: but in the multitude of counsellors there is safety.
verses.decoded: Without advice, people fail; with many advisers, there is safety.

verses.kjv: He that is surety for a stranger shall smart for it: and he that hateth suretiship is sure.
verses.decoded: If you guarantee a stranger’s debt, you will suffer for it; but those who avoid such promises are safe.

verses.kjv: A gracious woman retaineth honour: and strong men retain riches.
verses.decoded: A kind and graceful woman keeps her honor, and strong men hold on to their wealth.

verses.kjv: The merciful man doeth good to his own soul: but he that is cruel troubleth his own flesh.
verses.decoded: A merciful person benefits their own well-being, but a cruel person harms themselves.

verses.kjv: The wicked worketh a deceitful work: but to him that soweth righteousness shall be a sure reward.
verses.decoded: The wicked do dishonest things, but those who live rightly will receive a guaranteed reward.

verses.kjv: As righteousness tendeth to life: so he that pursueth evil pursueth it to his own death.
verses.decoded: Righteousness leads to life, but those who chase evil bring destruction on themselves.

verses.kjv: They that are of a froward heart are abomination to the LORD: but such as are upright in their way are his delight.
verses.decoded: Those with twisted hearts are detestable to the Lord, but those who live honestly please Him.

verses.kjv: Though hand join in hand, the wicked shall not be unpunished: but the seed of the righteous shall be delivered.
verses.decoded: Even if the wicked join forces, they will not escape punishment; but the descendants of the righteous will be saved.

verses.kjv: As a jewel of gold in a swine’s snout, so is a fair woman which is without discretion.
verses.decoded: Like a gold ring in a pig’s snout is a beautiful woman who lacks good judgment.

verses.kjv: The desire of the righteous is only good: but the expectation of the wicked is wrath.
verses.decoded: The righteous only wish for good things, but the wicked expect punishment.

verses.kjv: There is that scattereth, and yet increaseth; and there is that withholdeth more than is meet, but it tendeth to poverty.
verses.decoded: Some give freely and still grow richer; others hoard too much and end up poor.

verses.kjv: The liberal soul shall be made fat: and he that watereth shall be watered also himself.
verses.decoded: A generous person will prosper, and those who help others will themselves be helped.

verses.kjv: He that withholdeth corn, the people shall curse him: but blessing shall be upon the head of him that selleth it.
verses.decoded: Those who hoard grain will be cursed by the people, but those who sell it will be blessed.

verses.kjv: He that diligently seeketh good procureth favour: but he that seeketh mischief, it shall come unto him.
verses.decoded: Those who earnestly seek good will find favor, but those who look for trouble will get it.

verses.kjv: He that trusteth in his riches shall fall; but the righteous shall flourish as a branch.
verses.decoded: Those who rely on their wealth will fail, but the righteous will thrive like a healthy branch.

verses.kjv: He that troubleth his own house shall inherit the wind: and the fool shall be servant to the wise of heart.
verses.decoded: Anyone who causes problems in their own family will gain nothing, and fools will serve the wise.

verses.kjv: The fruit of the righteous is a tree of life; and he that winneth souls is wise.
verses.decoded: The good results of the righteous are like a life-giving tree, and those who lead others to God are wise.

verses.kjv: Behold, the righteous shall be recompensed in the earth: much more the wicked and the sinner.
verses.decoded: Look, the righteous will be rewarded in this life; how much more will the wicked and sinners face consequences.

verses.kjv: Whoso loveth instruction loveth knowledge: but he that hateth reproof is brutish.
verses.decoded: Anyone who loves being taught loves gaining knowledge, but anyone who hates correction is foolish.

verses.kjv: A good man obtaineth favour of the LORD: but a man of wicked devices will he condemn.
verses.decoded: A good person finds favor with the Lord, but someone who plans evil will be judged by Him.

verses.kjv: A man shall not be established by wickedness: but the root of the righteous shall not be moved.
verses.decoded: A person built on wickedness will not last, but the foundation of the righteous remains firm.

verses.kjv: A virtuous woman is a crown to her husband: but she that maketh ashamed is as rottenness in his bones.
verses.decoded: A woman of noble character brings honor to her husband, but one who brings shame is like decay in his bones.

verses.kjv: The thoughts of the righteous are right: but the counsels of the wicked are deceit.
verses.decoded: The plans of the righteous are honest, but the advice of the wicked is full of lies.

verses.kjv: The words of the wicked are to lie in wait for blood: but the mouth of the upright shall deliver them.
verses.decoded: The wicked use their words to trap and harm others, but the honest speak words that save and protect.

verses.kjv: The wicked are overthrown, and are not: but the house of the righteous shall stand.
verses.decoded: The wicked will be destroyed and disappear, but the family of the righteous will endure.

verses.kjv: A man shall be commended according to his wisdom: but he that is of a perverse heart shall be despised.
verses.decoded: A person is praised for their wisdom, but anyone with a twisted heart will be rejected.

verses.kjv: He that is despised, and hath a servant, is better than he that honoureth himself, and lacketh bread.
verses.decoded: Someone who is looked down upon but has servants is better off than someone who boasts but is poor.

verses.kjv: A righteous man regardeth the life of his beast: but the tender mercies of the wicked are cruel.
verses.decoded: A righteous person cares for the well-being of their animals, but even the kindness of the wicked is harsh.

verses.kjv: He that tilleth his land shall be satisfied with bread: but he that followeth vain persons is void of understanding.
verses.decoded: Those who work their land will have plenty to eat, but those who chase worthless people lack sense.

verses.kjv: The wicked desireth the net of evil men: but the root of the righteous yieldeth fruit.
verses.decoded: The wicked want to trap others with evil plans, but the foundation of the righteous produces good results.

verses.kjv: The wicked is snared by the transgression of his lips: but the just shall come out of trouble.
verses.decoded: The wicked get caught by the sins they speak, but the righteous will escape difficulties.

verses.kjv: A man shall be satisfied with good by the fruit of his mouth: and the recompence of a man’s hands shall be rendered unto him.
verses.decoded: A person enjoys the benefits of their good words, and will be rewarded according to their actions.

verses.kjv: The way of a fool is right in his own eyes: but he that hearkeneth unto counsel is wise.
verses.decoded: A fool thinks their way is always right, but a wise person listens to advice.

verses.kjv: A fool’s wrath is presently known: but a prudent man covereth shame.
verses.decoded: A fool quickly shows his anger, but a wise person hides disgrace.

verses.kjv: He that speaketh truth sheweth forth righteousness: but a false witness deceit.
verses.decoded: Anyone who tells the truth shows what is right, but a false witness spreads lies.

verses.kjv: There is that speaketh like the piercings of a sword: but the tongue of the wise is health.
verses.decoded: Some speak words that hurt like a sword, but the wise speak words that bring healing.

verses.kjv: The lip of truth shall be established for ever: but a lying tongue is but for a moment.
verses.decoded: Truthful words last forever, but lies only last a short time.

verses.kjv: Deceit is in the heart of them that imagine evil: but to the counsellors of peace is joy.
verses.decoded: Those who plan evil have deceit in their hearts, but those who advise peace have joy.

verses.kjv: There shall no evil happen to the just: but the wicked shall be filled with mischief.
verses.decoded: Nothing harmful will happen to the righteous, but the wicked will be full of trouble.

verses.kjv: Lying lips are abomination to the LORD: but they that deal truly are his delight.
verses.decoded: Lying lips are hateful to the Lord, but those who are honest please Him.

verses.kjv: A prudent man concealeth knowledge: but the heart of fools proclaimeth foolishness.
verses.decoded: A wise person keeps knowledge to themselves, but fools openly share their foolishness.

verses.kjv: The hand of the diligent shall bear rule: but the slothful shall be under tribute.
verses.decoded: Hardworking people will lead, but lazy people will be forced to serve others.

verses.kjv: Heaviness in the heart of man maketh it stoop: but a good word maketh it glad.
verses.decoded: Worry weighs a person down, but a kind word cheers them up.

verses.kjv: The righteous is more excellent than his neighbour: but the way of the wicked seduceth them.
verses.decoded: The righteous are better than their neighbors, but the wicked lead others astray.

verses.kjv: The slothful man roasteth not that which he took in hunting: but the substance of a diligent man is precious.
verses.decoded: A lazy person won’t even cook what they caught, but a hardworking person’s possessions are valuable.

verses.kjv: In the way of righteousness is life: and in the pathway thereof there is no death.
verses.decoded: Following the path of righteousness leads to life; there is no death on that way.

verses.kjv: A wise son heareth his father’s instruction: but a scorner heareth not rebuke.
verses.decoded: A wise child listens to their father's teaching, but a mocker refuses to accept correction.

verses.kjv: A man shall eat good by the fruit of his mouth: but the soul of the transgressors shall eat violence.
verses.decoded: A person enjoys good things because of what they say, but those who do wrong bring harm upon themselves.

verses.kjv: He that keepeth his mouth keepeth his life: but he that openeth wide his lips shall have destruction.
verses.decoded: Those who control their speech protect their lives, but those who speak carelessly will face ruin.

verses.kjv: The soul of the sluggard desireth, and hath nothing: but the soul of the diligent shall be made fat.
verses.decoded: A lazy person wants things but gets nothing, while a hardworking person is well provided for.

verses.kjv: A righteous man hateth lying: but a wicked man is loathsome, and cometh to shame.
verses.decoded: A good person hates lies, but a wicked person is disgusting and brings shame on themselves.

verses.kjv: Righteousness keepeth him that is upright in the way: but wickedness overthroweth the sinner.
verses.decoded: Living rightly protects those who follow the right path, but evil causes sinners to fall.

verses.kjv: There is that maketh himself rich, yet hath nothing: there is that maketh himself poor, yet hath great riches.
verses.decoded: Some pretend to be rich but have nothing, while others seem poor but are truly wealthy.

verses.kjv: The ransom of a man’s life are his riches: but the poor heareth not rebuke.
verses.decoded: A person's wealth can save their life, but the poor ignore correction.

verses.kjv: The light of the righteous rejoiceth: but the lamp of the wicked shall be put out.
verses.decoded: The good person's light shines brightly, but the wicked person's light will be extinguished.

verses.kjv: Only by pride cometh contention: but with the well advised is wisdom.
verses.decoded: Arguments come from pride, but wise people seek good advice.

verses.kjv: Wealth gotten by vanity shall be diminished: but he that gathereth by labour shall increase.
verses.decoded: Money gained quickly and dishonestly will disappear, but wealth earned through hard work will grow.

verses.kjv: Hope deferred maketh the heart sick: but when the desire cometh, it is a tree of life.
verses.decoded: Waiting too long for hope can cause sadness, but when dreams come true, they bring life and joy.

verses.kjv: Whoso despiseth the word shall be destroyed: but he that feareth the commandment shall be rewarded.
verses.decoded: Those who reject God's word will be ruined, but those who respect His commands will be blessed.

verses.kjv: The law of the wise is a fountain of life, to depart from the snares of death.
verses.decoded: The teachings of the wise bring life and help avoid deadly traps.

verses.kjv: Good understanding giveth favour: but the way of transgressors is hard.
verses.decoded: Having good sense brings favor, but the path of those who break rules is difficult.

verses.kjv: Every prudent man dealeth with knowledge: but a fool layeth open his folly.
verses.decoded: A wise person acts with understanding, but a fool openly shows his foolishness.

verses.kjv: A wicked messenger falleth into mischief: but a faithful ambassador is health.
verses.decoded: A dishonest messenger causes trouble, but a trustworthy representative brings healing.

verses.kjv: Poverty and shame shall be to him that refuseth instruction: but he that regardeth reproof shall be honoured.
verses.decoded: Those who refuse to accept correction will suffer poverty and disgrace, but those who listen to advice will be respected.

verses.kjv: The desire accomplished is sweet to the soul: but it is abomination to fools to depart from evil.
verses.decoded: Achieving your desires is satisfying to your soul, but fools hate turning away from doing wrong.

verses.kjv: He that walketh with wise men shall be wise: but a companion of fools shall be destroyed.
verses.decoded: Whoever spends time with wise people will become wise, but those who associate with fools will suffer harm.

verses.kjv: Evil pursueth sinners: but to the righteous good shall be repayed.
verses.decoded: Trouble follows sinners, but good things come to those who are righteous.

verses.kjv: A good man leaveth an inheritance to his children’s children: and the wealth of the sinner is laid up for the just.
verses.decoded: A good person leaves an inheritance for their grandchildren, but the wealth of sinners will be given to the righteous.

verses.kjv: Much food is in the tillage of the poor: but there is that is destroyed for want of judgment.
verses.decoded: The land worked by the poor produces plenty of food, but poor decisions can lead to loss.

verses.kjv: He that spareth his rod hateth his son: but he that loveth him chasteneth him betimes.
verses.decoded: Those who refuse to discipline their children do not truly care for them, but those who love their children correct them early.

verses.kjv: The righteous eateth to the satisfying of his soul: but the belly of the wicked shall want.
verses.decoded: The righteous eat and feel satisfied, but the wicked will go hungry.

verses.kjv: Every wise woman buildeth her house: but the foolish plucketh it down with her hands.
verses.decoded: A wise woman carefully builds and maintains her home, but a foolish woman destroys it with her own actions.

verses.kjv: He that walketh in his uprightness feareth the LORD: but he that is perverse in his ways despiseth him.
verses.decoded: Those who live honestly respect the Lord, but those who act dishonestly reject Him.

verses.kjv: In the mouth of the foolish is a rod of pride: but the lips of the wise shall preserve them.
verses.decoded: Foolish people speak arrogantly, but wise people use their words to protect themselves.

verses.kjv: Where no oxen are, the crib is clean: but much increase is by the strength of the ox.
verses.decoded: Without oxen, the feeding trough stays clean, but having oxen brings great harvests.

verses.kjv: A faithful witness will not lie: but a false witness will utter lies.
verses.decoded: A trustworthy witness tells the truth, but a dishonest one tells lies.

verses.kjv: A scorner seeketh wisdom, and findeth it not: but knowledge is easy unto him that understandeth.
verses.decoded: A mocker tries to find wisdom but fails; understanding comes easily to those who are teachable.

verses.kjv: Go from the presence of a foolish man, when thou perceivest not in him the lips of knowledge.
verses.decoded: Leave the company of a foolish person when you realize they have nothing wise to say.

verses.kjv: The wisdom of the prudent is to understand his way: but the folly of fools is deceit.
verses.decoded: A sensible person wisely considers their actions, but fools are known for their dishonesty.

verses.kjv: Fools make a mock at sin: but among the righteous there is favour.
verses.decoded: Fools laugh at wrongdoing, but those who live rightly receive favor.

verses.kjv: The heart knoweth his own bitterness; and a stranger doth not intermeddle with his joy.
verses.decoded: Only a person truly understands their own pain, and outsiders cannot share in their happiness.

verses.kjv: The house of the wicked shall be overthrown: but the tabernacle of the upright shall flourish.
verses.decoded: The home of the wicked will be destroyed, but the dwelling of the righteous will thrive.

verses.kjv: There is a way which seemeth right unto a man, but the end thereof are the ways of death.
verses.decoded: A path may look right to someone, but it ultimately leads to destruction.

verses.kjv: Even in laughter the heart is sorrowful; and the end of that mirth is heaviness.
verses.decoded: Even when people laugh, their hearts may be sad, and their joy can end in sorrow.

verses.kjv: The backslider in heart shall be filled with his own ways: and a good man shall be satisfied from himself.
verses.decoded: A person who turns away from good will face the consequences of their choices, but a good person will find contentment within themselves.

verses.kjv: The simple believeth every word: but the prudent man looketh well to his going.
verses.decoded: A naive person believes everything they hear, but a wise person carefully considers their steps.

verses.kjv: A wise man feareth, and departeth from evil: but the fool rageth, and is confident.
verses.decoded: A wise person is careful and avoids evil, but a fool gets angry easily and is overconfident.

verses.kjv: He that is soon angry dealeth foolishly: and a man of wicked devices is hated.
verses.decoded: Someone who gets angry quickly acts foolishly, and people dislike those who plan evil.

verses.kjv: The simple inherit folly: but the prudent are crowned with knowledge.
verses.decoded: Foolish people end up with foolishness, but wise people are rewarded with knowledge.

verses.kjv: The evil bow before the good; and the wicked at the gates of the righteous.
verses.decoded: Evil people submit to good people, and the wicked respect those who are righteous.

verses.kjv: The poor is hated even of his own neighbour: but the rich hath many friends.
verses.decoded: Poor people are often disliked even by those close to them, but rich people have many friends.

verses.kjv: He that despiseth his neighbour sinneth: but he that hath mercy on the poor, happy is he.
verses.decoded: Those who look down on others sin, but those who show kindness to the poor are truly happy.

verses.kjv: Do they not err that devise evil? but mercy and truth shall be to them that devise good.
verses.decoded: Those who plan evil are mistaken, but kindness and honesty come to those who plan good.

verses.kjv: In all labour there is profit: but the talk of the lips tendeth only to penury.
verses.decoded: Hard work always brings some benefit, but just talking leads to poverty.

verses.kjv: The crown of the wise is their riches: but the foolishness of fools is folly.
verses.decoded: The reward for wise people is their wealth, but fools only have foolishness.

verses.kjv: A true witness delivereth souls: but a deceitful witness speaketh lies.
verses.decoded: An honest witness saves lives, but a lying witness tells falsehoods.

verses.kjv: In the fear of the LORD is strong confidence: and his children shall have a place of refuge.
verses.decoded: Respecting the Lord gives strong confidence, and their descendants will find safety.

verses.kjv: The fear of the LORD is a fountain of life, to depart from the snares of death.
verses.decoded: Respecting the Lord is like a spring of life that keeps you away from deadly traps.

verses.kjv: In the multitude of people is the king’s honour: but in the want of people is the destruction of the prince.
verses.decoded: A king’s honor comes from having many people, but a leader’s downfall comes from having few.

verses.kjv: He that is slow to wrath is of great understanding: but he that is hasty of spirit exalteth folly.
verses.decoded: Those who are slow to anger are very wise, but quick-tempered people promote foolishness.

verses.kjv: A sound heart is the life of the flesh: but envy the rottenness of the bones.
verses.decoded: A healthy heart gives life to the body, but jealousy eats away like decay in the bones.

verses.kjv: He that oppresseth the poor reproacheth his Maker: but he that honoureth him hath mercy on the poor.
verses.decoded: Anyone who mistreats the poor is insulting God, but those who respect God show kindness to the poor.

verses.kjv: The wicked is driven away in his wickedness: but the righteous hath hope in his death.
verses.decoded: A wicked person is overwhelmed by their own evil, but a righteous person has hope even in death.

verses.kjv: Wisdom resteth in the heart of him that hath understanding: but that which is in the midst of fools is made known.
verses.decoded: Wisdom lives in the heart of someone who understands, but foolishness is obvious among fools.

verses.kjv: Righteousness exalteth a nation: but sin is a reproach to any people.
verses.decoded: Doing what is right lifts up a nation, but sin brings shame to any group of people.

verses.kjv: The king’s favour is toward a wise servant: but his wrath is against him that causeth shame.
