verses.decoded: A wise servant earns the king’s favor, but one who brings disgrace faces his anger.

verses.kjv: A soft answer turneth away wrath: but grievous words stir up anger.
verses.decoded: A gentle reply calms anger, but harsh words make people more angry.

verses.kjv: The tongue of the wise useth knowledge aright: but the mouth of fools poureth out foolishness.
verses.decoded: Wise people speak with knowledge and understanding, but fools speak nonsense.

verses.kjv: The eyes of the LORD are in every place, beholding the evil and the good.
verses.decoded: God watches everywhere, seeing both the good and the evil actions of people.

verses.kjv: A wholesome tongue is a tree of life: but perverseness therein is a breach in the spirit.
verses.decoded: Kind and healing words bring life and health, but twisted words harm the spirit.

verses.kjv: A fool despiseth his father’s instruction: but he that regardeth reproof is prudent.
verses.decoded: A fool rejects his father's teaching, but a wise person accepts correction.

verses.kjv: In the house of the righteous is much treasure: but in the revenues of the wicked is trouble.
verses.decoded: The home of a good person is full of valuable things, but the wealth of the wicked brings problems.

verses.kjv: The lips of the wise disperse knowledge: but the heart of the foolish doeth not so.
verses.decoded: Wise people share knowledge with others, but fools keep it to themselves or ignore it.

verses.kjv: The sacrifice of the wicked is an abomination to the LORD: but the prayer of the upright is his delight.
verses.decoded: God hates offerings from wicked people, but he is pleased with the prayers of honest people.

verses.kjv: The way of the wicked is an abomination unto the LORD: but he loveth him that followeth after righteousness.
verses.decoded: God detests the path of evil people, but he loves those who pursue what is right.

verses.kjv: Correction is grievous unto him that forsaketh the way: and he that hateth reproof shall die.
verses.decoded: Correction is painful for those who have turned away from the right path, and those who hate being corrected will suffer serious consequences.

verses.kjv: Hell and destruction are before the LORD: how much more then the hearts of the children of men?
verses.decoded: God sees the depths of hell and destruction; how much more does he understand human hearts?

verses.kjv: A scorner loveth not one that reproveth him: neither will he go unto the wise.
verses.decoded: A mocker hates anyone who corrects him and refuses to listen to wise people.

verses.kjv: A merry heart maketh a cheerful countenance: but by sorrow of the heart the spirit is broken.
verses.decoded: A joyful heart shows in a happy face, but sadness can crush a person's spirit.

verses.kjv: The heart of him that hath understanding seeketh knowledge: but the mouth of fools feedeth on foolishness.
verses.decoded: A wise person desires to learn more, but fools speak only nonsense.

verses.kjv: All the days of the afflicted are evil: but he that is of a merry heart hath a continual feast.
verses.decoded: Those who are troubled feel that every day is bad, but a cheerful person feels like every day is a celebration.

verses.kjv: Better is little with the fear of the LORD than great treasure and trouble therewith.
verses.decoded: It is better to have little with reverence for the Lord than to have great wealth accompanied by problems.

verses.kjv: Better is a dinner of herbs where love is, than a stalled ox and hatred therewith.
verses.decoded: A simple meal shared with love is better than a large feast with hatred.

verses.kjv: A wrathful man stirreth up strife: but he that is slow to anger appeaseth strife.
verses.decoded: A hot-tempered person causes conflict, but someone who is patient calms arguments.

verses.kjv: The way of the slothful man is as an hedge of thorns: but the way of the righteous is made plain.
verses.decoded: The path of a lazy person is like a thorny fence, difficult to walk; but the path of the righteous is clear and easy to follow.

verses.kjv: A wise son maketh a glad father: but a foolish man despiseth his mother.
verses.decoded: A wise child brings joy to their father, but a foolish person shows disrespect to their mother.

verses.kjv: Folly is joy to him that is destitute of wisdom: but a man of understanding walketh uprightly.
verses.decoded: Foolishness delights those without wisdom, but a person with understanding lives honestly.

verses.kjv: Without counsel purposes are disappointed: but in the multitude of counsellors they are established.
verses.decoded: Plans fail without advice, but with many advisors they succeed.

verses.kjv: A man hath joy by the answer of his mouth: and a word spoken in due season, how good is it!
verses.decoded: A person feels joy when they give the right answer, and a timely word is very good.

verses.kjv: The way of life is above to the wise, that he may depart from hell beneath.
verses.decoded: The wise see the path of life as high and safe, leading them away from death below.

verses.kjv: The LORD will destroy the house of the proud: but he will establish the border of the widow.
verses.decoded: God will bring down the proud but protect the boundaries of widows.

verses.kjv: The thoughts of the wicked are an abomination to the LORD: but the words of the pure are pleasant words.
verses.decoded: The Lord hates the plans of the wicked, but the words of pure people are pleasing to Him.

verses.kjv: He that is greedy of gain troubleth his own house; but he that hateth gifts shall live.
verses.decoded: A person greedy for wealth causes problems at home, but one who refuses bribes will live.

verses.kjv: The heart of the righteous studieth to answer: but the mouth of the wicked poureth out evil things.
verses.decoded: A righteous person carefully considers their response, but a wicked person speaks harmful words freely.

verses.kjv: The LORD is far from the wicked: but he heareth the prayer of the righteous.
verses.decoded: God is distant from the wicked, but listens to the prayers of the righteous.

verses.kjv: The light of the eyes rejoiceth the heart: and a good report maketh the bones fat.
verses.decoded: A joyful look brightens the heart, and good news strengthens the body.

verses.kjv: The ear that heareth the reproof of life abideth among the wise.
verses.decoded: Those who listen to correction that leads to life remain among the wise.

verses.kjv: He that refuseth instruction despiseth his own soul: but he that heareth reproof getteth understanding.
verses.decoded: Anyone who refuses to accept guidance shows contempt for themselves, but those who accept correction gain insight.

verses.kjv: The fear of the LORD is the instruction of wisdom; and before honour is humility.
verses.decoded: Respecting the LORD is the foundation of wisdom; and humility comes before honor.

verses.kjv: The preparations of the heart in man, and the answer of the tongue, is from the LORD.
verses.decoded: People plan what they want to do in their hearts, but the words they speak come from the LORD.

verses.kjv: All the ways of a man are clean in his own eyes; but the LORD weigheth the spirits.
verses.decoded: Everyone thinks their own actions are right, but the LORD examines their true motives.

verses.kjv: Commit thy works unto the LORD, and thy thoughts shall be established.
verses.decoded: Entrust your plans and actions to the LORD, and your ideas will succeed.

verses.kjv: The LORD hath made all things for himself: yea, even the wicked for the day of evil.
verses.decoded: The LORD created everything for His purposes, including the wicked for the time of judgment.

verses.kjv: Every one that is proud in heart is an abomination to the LORD: though hand join in hand, he shall not be unpunished.
verses.decoded: Anyone who is proud is hateful to the LORD; even if they unite with others, they will not go unpunished.

verses.kjv: By mercy and truth iniquity is purged: and by the fear of the LORD men depart from evil.
verses.decoded: Through kindness and honesty, sins are forgiven; and respecting the LORD causes people to turn away from evil.

verses.kjv: When a man’s ways please the LORD, he maketh even his enemies to be at peace with him.
verses.decoded: If a person lives in a way that pleases the LORD, even their enemies will be at peace with them.

verses.kjv: Better is a little with righteousness than great revenues without right.
verses.decoded: It is better to have little with honesty than to have great wealth gained by dishonest means.

verses.kjv: A man’s heart deviseth his way: but the LORD directeth his steps.
verses.decoded: People plan their own paths, but the LORD guides their steps.

verses.kjv: A divine sentence is in the lips of the king: his mouth transgresseth not in judgment.
verses.decoded: The king’s words are like divine decisions; he does not make mistakes when judging.

verses.kjv: A just weight and balance are the LORD’s: all the weights of the bag are his work.
verses.decoded: Fair scales and honest measurements belong to the LORD; all measuring tools are His creation.

verses.kjv: It is an abomination to kings to commit wickedness: for the throne is established by righteousness.
verses.decoded: Kings hate doing wrong because their authority is based on justice.

verses.kjv: Righteous lips are the delight of kings; and they love him that speaketh right.
verses.decoded: Kings enjoy hearing honest words and love those who speak truth.

verses.kjv: The wrath of a king is as messengers of death: but a wise man will pacify it.
verses.decoded: A king’s anger can bring death, but a wise person knows how to calm it down.

verses.kjv: In the light of the king’s countenance is life; and his favour is as a cloud of the latter rain.
verses.decoded: When the king looks favorably upon you, it brings life and blessing, like the refreshing rain at the right time.

verses.kjv: How much better is it to get wisdom than gold! and to get understanding rather to be chosen than silver!
verses.decoded: It is far better to gain wisdom than to gain gold, and choosing understanding is better than choosing silver.

verses.kjv: The highway of the upright is to depart from evil: he that keepeth his way preserveth his soul.
verses.decoded: The path for honest people is to avoid evil; those who follow this path protect their lives.

verses.kjv: Pride goeth before destruction, and an haughty spirit before a fall.
verses.decoded: Pride leads to ruin, and arrogance leads to a downfall.

verses.kjv: Better it is to be of an humble spirit with the lowly, than to divide the spoil with the proud.
verses.decoded: It is better to be humble among the poor than to share in the rewards with the proud.

verses.kjv: He that handleth a matter wisely shall find good: and whoso trusteth in the LORD, happy is he.
verses.decoded: Those who deal wisely with situations will find success, and those who trust in the LORD are truly happy.

verses.kjv: The wise in heart shall be called prudent: and the sweetness of the lips increaseth learning.
verses.decoded: A wise person is known for good judgment, and kind words encourage learning.

verses.kjv: Understanding is a wellspring of life unto him that hath it: but the instruction of fools is folly.
verses.decoded: Understanding brings life to those who have it, but the teaching of fools leads to foolishness.

verses.kjv: The heart of the wise teacheth his mouth, and addeth learning to his lips.
verses.decoded: A wise person's heart guides what they say, adding knowledge to their words.

verses.kjv: Pleasant words are as an honeycomb, sweet to the soul, and health to the bones.
verses.decoded: Kind and gentle words are like honeycomb—sweet to the soul and good for your health.

verses.kjv: There is a way that seemeth right unto a man, but the end thereof are the ways of death.
verses.decoded: There is a path that seems right to a person, but it ultimately leads to death.

verses.kjv: He that laboureth laboureth for himself; for his mouth craveth it of him.
verses.decoded: A person who works hard does so for their own benefit, because their desires demand it.

verses.kjv: An ungodly man diggeth up evil: and in his lips there is as a burning fire.
verses.decoded: A wicked person plans evil, and their words are like a burning fire.

verses.kjv: A froward man soweth strife: and a whisperer separateth chief friends.
verses.decoded: A dishonest person causes conflict, and a gossip breaks apart close friendships.

verses.kjv: A violent man enticeth his neighbour, and leadeth him into the way that is not good.
verses.decoded: A violent person tempts their neighbor and leads them down a harmful path.

verses.kjv: He shutteth his eyes to devise froward things: moving his lips he bringeth evil to pass.
verses.decoded: Someone who closes their eyes to plot evil and uses their words to carry it out.

verses.kjv: The hoary head is a crown of glory, if it be found in the way of righteousness.
verses.decoded: Gray hair is like a crown of honor, especially when it is earned by living a righteous life.

verses.kjv: He that is slow to anger is better than the mighty; and he that ruleth his spirit than he that taketh a city.
verses.decoded: Being patient and controlling your temper is better than being physically strong; mastering yourself is greater than conquering a city.

verses.kjv: The lot is cast into the lap; but the whole disposing thereof is of the LORD.
verses.decoded: People may cast lots to make decisions, but the outcome is ultimately determined by the Lord.

verses.kjv: Better is a dry morsel, and quietness therewith, than an house full of sacrifices with strife.
verses.decoded: It is better to eat a simple meal in peace than to have a house full of feasts accompanied by conflict.

verses.kjv: A wise servant shall have rule over a son that causeth shame, and shall have part of the inheritance among the brethren.
verses.decoded: A wise servant will rule over a disgraceful son and share in the family inheritance with the siblings.

verses.kjv: The fining pot is for silver, and the furnace for gold: but the LORD trieth the hearts.
verses.decoded: Just as silver is purified in a refining pot and gold in a furnace, the LORD tests the hearts of people.

verses.kjv: A wicked doer giveth heed to false lips; and a liar giveth ear to a naughty tongue.
verses.decoded: A wicked person listens to deceitful words, and a liar pays attention to corrupt speech.

verses.kjv: Whoso mocketh the poor reproacheth his Maker: and he that is glad at calamities shall not be unpunished.
verses.decoded: Anyone who mocks the poor insults their Creator, and those who rejoice in disaster will not go unpunished.

verses.kjv: Children’s children are the crown of old men; and the glory of children are their fathers.
verses.decoded: Grandchildren are the pride of the elderly, and children honor their parents.

verses.kjv: Excellent speech becometh not a fool: much less do lying lips a prince.
verses.decoded: Wise and noble words do not suit a fool, and lying lips are even less fitting for a ruler.

verses.kjv: A gift is as a precious stone in the eyes of him that hath it: whithersoever it turneth, it prospereth.
verses.decoded: A gift is like a valuable gem to the person who receives it; wherever it goes, it brings success.

verses.kjv: He that covereth a transgression seeketh love; but he that repeateth a matter separateth very friends.
verses.decoded: Someone who forgives an offense seeks love, but one who keeps bringing it up divides close friends.

verses.kjv: A reproof entereth more into a wise man than an hundred stripes into a fool.
verses.decoded: A wise person is more affected by a single correction than a fool is by a hundred lashes.

verses.kjv: An evil man seeketh only rebellion: therefore a cruel messenger shall be sent against him.
verses.decoded: An evil person stirs up trouble, so a harsh punishment will come upon him.

verses.kjv: Let a bear robbed of her whelps meet a man, rather than a fool in his folly.
verses.decoded: It is better to face a mother bear whose cubs have been taken than to deal with a fool acting in his foolishness.

verses.kjv: Whoso rewardeth evil for good, evil shall not depart from his house.
verses.decoded: Anyone who repays kindness with evil will never have peace in their home.

verses.kjv: The beginning of strife is as when one letteth out water: therefore leave off contention, before it be meddled with.
verses.decoded: Starting a quarrel is like letting water escape; stop the fight before it gets out of control.

verses.kjv: He that justifieth the wicked, and he that condemneth the just, even they both are abomination to the LORD.
verses.decoded: Those who declare the guilty innocent and condemn the innocent are both detestable to the LORD.

verses.kjv: Wherefore is there a price in the hand of a fool to get wisdom, seeing he hath no heart to it?
verses.decoded: Why would a fool pay for wisdom when he has no desire for it?

verses.kjv: A friend loveth at all times, and a brother is born for adversity.
verses.decoded: A true friend loves you always, and a brother is there to help in difficult times.

verses.kjv: A man void of understanding striketh hands, and becometh surety in the presence of his friend.
verses.decoded: A foolish person makes agreements and guarantees debts without thinking, even in front of friends.

verses.kjv: He loveth transgression that loveth strife: and he that exalteth his gate seeketh destruction.
verses.decoded: Anyone who loves conflict also loves wrongdoing; and someone who is proud and arrogant invites ruin.

verses.kjv: He that hath a froward heart findeth no good: and he that hath a perverse tongue falleth into mischief.
verses.decoded: A person with a stubborn, twisted heart will find no good, and someone who speaks deceitfully will cause trouble.

verses.kjv: He that begetteth a fool doeth it to his sorrow: and the father of a fool hath no joy.
verses.decoded: Having a foolish child brings sorrow, and a father of a fool has no happiness.

verses.kjv: A merry heart doeth good like a medicine: but a broken spirit drieth the bones.
verses.decoded: A cheerful heart is good medicine, but a crushed spirit dries up the bones.

verses.kjv: A wicked man taketh a gift out of the bosom to pervert the ways of judgment.
verses.decoded: A wicked person accepts bribes secretly to twist justice.

verses.kjv: Wisdom is before him that hath understanding; but the eyes of a fool are in the ends of the earth.
verses.decoded: Wisdom is available to those who understand, but a fool looks everywhere except where it truly matters.

verses.kjv: A foolish son is a grief to his father, and bitterness to her that bare him.
verses.decoded: A foolish son causes sorrow to his father and bitterness to his mother.

verses.kjv: Also to punish the just is not good, nor to strike princes for equity.
verses.decoded: It is wrong to punish the innocent or to discipline leaders who act fairly.

verses.kjv: He that hath knowledge spareth his words: and a man of understanding is of an excellent spirit.
verses.decoded: A knowledgeable person speaks carefully, and a wise person has a calm and excellent spirit.

verses.kjv: Even a fool, when he holdeth his peace, is counted wise: and he that shutteth his lips is esteemed a man of understanding.
verses.decoded: Even a fool is thought wise if he stays silent; those who keep quiet are seen as understanding.

verses.kjv: Through desire a man, having separated himself, seeketh and intermeddleth with all wisdom.
verses.decoded: A person who isolates themselves because of their own desires tries to get involved in every kind of wisdom and knowledge.

verses.kjv: A fool hath no delight in understanding, but that his heart may discover itself.
verses.decoded: A fool doesn’t enjoy gaining understanding; instead, they just want to express their own thoughts.

verses.kjv: When the wicked cometh, then cometh also contempt, and with ignominy reproach.
verses.decoded: When evil people arrive, disrespect and shame come along with them.

verses.kjv: The words of a man’s mouth are as deep waters, and the wellspring of wisdom as a flowing brook.
verses.decoded: A person’s words can be like deep waters, and the source of wisdom flows like a gentle stream.

verses.kjv: It is not good to accept the person of the wicked, to overthrow the righteous in judgment.
verses.decoded: It is wrong to favor evil people and to condemn the innocent unfairly.

verses.kjv: A fool’s lips enter into contention, and his mouth calleth for strokes.
verses.decoded: A fool’s words cause arguments and invite punishment.

verses.kjv: A fool’s mouth is his destruction, and his lips are the snare of his soul.
verses.decoded: What a fool says leads to their downfall and traps their very life.

verses.kjv: The words of a talebearer are as wounds, and they go down into the innermost parts of the belly.
verses.decoded: Gossiping words hurt like wounds and affect a person deeply inside.

verses.kjv: He also that is slothful in his work is brother to him that is a great waster.
verses.decoded: Someone lazy at their job is like a person who destroys everything.

verses.kjv: The name of the LORD is a strong tower: the righteous runneth into it, and is safe.
verses.decoded: The LORD’s name is a strong refuge; the righteous run to Him and are protected.

verses.kjv: The rich man’s wealth is his strong city, and as an high wall in his own conceit.
verses.decoded: A rich person trusts their wealth like a fortress and feels secure because of it.

verses.kjv: Before destruction the heart of man is haughty, and before honour is humility.
verses.decoded: Pride comes before ruin, but humility comes before honor.

verses.kjv: He that answereth a matter before he heareth it, it is folly and shame unto him.
verses.decoded: Answering before listening is foolish and brings shame.

verses.kjv: The spirit of a man will sustain his infirmity; but a wounded spirit who can bear?
verses.decoded: A person’s spirit can support them through illness, but a broken spirit is hard to endure.

verses.kjv: The heart of the prudent getteth knowledge; and the ear of the wise seeketh knowledge.
verses.decoded: A wise person’s heart gains knowledge, and their ears are always open to learning.

verses.kjv: A man’s gift maketh room for him, and bringeth him before great men.
verses.decoded: A person's gift opens doors for them and brings them into the presence of important people.

verses.kjv: He that is first in his own cause seemeth just; but his neighbour cometh and searcheth him.
verses.decoded: The first person to present their case seems right, but their neighbor comes and investigates the truth.

verses.kjv: The lot causeth contentions to cease, and parteth between the mighty.
verses.decoded: Casting lots ends arguments and settles disputes among powerful people.

verses.kjv: A brother offended is harder to be won than a strong city: and their contentions are like the bars of a castle.
verses.decoded: An offended brother is harder to win back than a fortified city; their disagreements are like strong barriers.

verses.kjv: A man’s belly shall be satisfied with the fruit of his mouth; and with the increase of his lips shall he be filled.
verses.decoded: A person’s words can bring satisfaction and fulfillment, like food satisfies hunger.

verses.kjv: Death and life are in the power of the tongue: and they that love it shall eat the fruit thereof.
verses.decoded: The tongue has the power to bring death or life; those who enjoy speaking will experience the consequences of their words.

verses.kjv: Whoso findeth a wife findeth a good thing, and obtaineth favour of the LORD.
verses.decoded: Whoever finds a wife finds something good and receives the Lord’s favor.

verses.kjv: The poor useth intreaties; but the rich answereth roughly.
verses.decoded: The poor plead for help, but the rich respond harshly.

verses.kjv: A man that hath friends must shew himself friendly: and there is a friend that sticketh closer than a brother.
verses.decoded: Anyone who wants friends must be friendly, and some friends are even closer than family.

verses.kjv: Better is the poor that walketh in his integrity, than he that is perverse in his lips, and is a fool.
verses.decoded: It is better to be a poor person who lives honestly than to be someone who speaks dishonestly and acts foolishly.

verses.kjv: Also, that the soul be without knowledge, it is not good; and he that hasteth with his feet sinneth.
verses.decoded: It is not good for a person to lack understanding, and rushing into things often leads to sin.

verses.kjv: The foolishness of man perverteth his way: and his heart fretteth against the LORD.
verses.decoded: A person's foolishness leads them away from the right path, and their heart becomes angry with God.

verses.kjv: Wealth maketh many friends; but the poor is separated from his neighbour.
verses.decoded: Having wealth attracts many friends, but a poor person is often avoided by others.

verses.kjv: A false witness shall not be unpunished, and he that speaketh lies shall not escape.
verses.decoded: A false witness will not go free; anyone who tells lies will face consequences.

verses.kjv: Many will intreat the favour of the prince: and every man is a friend to him that giveth gifts.
verses.decoded: Many people seek the favor of a ruler, and everyone is friendly to someone who gives gifts.

verses.kjv: All the brethren of the poor do hate him: how much more do his friends go far from him? he pursueth them with words, yet they are wanting to him.
verses.decoded: Even the poor person's relatives dislike him; his friends avoid him even more. He calls out to them, but they ignore him.

verses.kjv: He that getteth wisdom loveth his own soul: he that keepeth understanding shall find good.
verses.decoded: Anyone who gains wisdom cares for their own well-being; those who hold on to understanding will find good things.

verses.kjv: A false witness shall not be unpunished, and he that speaketh lies shall perish.
verses.decoded: A false witness will not go free, and anyone who tells lies will be destroyed.

verses.kjv: Delight is not seemly for a fool; much less for a servant to have rule over princes.
verses.decoded: It is not appropriate for a fool to be happy, and even less appropriate for a servant to rule over kings.

verses.kjv: The discretion of a man deferreth his anger; and it is his glory to pass over a transgression.
verses.decoded: A wise person controls their anger and is honorable by forgiving offenses.

verses.kjv: The king’s wrath is as the roaring of a lion; but his favour is as dew upon the grass.
verses.decoded: The anger of a king is like a roaring lion, but his favor is like gentle dew on grass.

verses.kjv: A foolish son is the calamity of his father: and the contentions of a wife are a continual dropping.
verses.decoded: A foolish son brings trouble to his father, and constant arguments with a wife are like dripping water that never stops.

verses.kjv: House and riches are the inheritance of fathers: and a prudent wife is from the LORD.
verses.decoded: A house and wealth come from a father’s inheritance, but a wise wife is a gift from the Lord.

verses.kjv: Slothfulness casteth into a deep sleep; and an idle soul shall suffer hunger.
verses.decoded: Laziness leads to deep sleep, and a person who does nothing will go hungry.

verses.kjv: He that keepeth the commandment keepeth his own soul; but he that despiseth his ways shall die.
verses.decoded: Those who obey God's commands protect their own lives, but those who ignore their own ways will face death.

verses.kjv: He that hath pity upon the poor lendeth unto the LORD; and that which he hath given will he pay him again.
verses.decoded: Showing kindness to the poor is like lending to the Lord, and He will repay you for what you have done.

verses.kjv: Chasten thy son while there is hope, and let not thy soul spare for his crying.
verses.decoded: Discipline your son while there is still hope; don’t hold back even if he cries.

verses.kjv: A man of great wrath shall suffer punishment: for if thou deliver him, yet thou must do it again.
verses.decoded: A person who is quick to anger will face consequences; even if you help him once, you’ll have to help him again.

verses.kjv: Hear counsel, and receive instruction, that thou mayest be wise in thy latter end.
verses.decoded: Listen to advice and accept instruction so you can be wise in the future.

verses.kjv: There are many devices in a man’s heart; nevertheless the counsel of the LORD, that shall stand.
verses.decoded: People may have many plans in their hearts, but only God’s purpose will succeed.

verses.kjv: The desire of a man is his kindness: and a poor man is better than a liar.
verses.decoded: A person's true wish is to be kind; and a poor person who is honest is better than a liar.

verses.kjv: The fear of the LORD tendeth to life: and he that hath it shall abide satisfied; he shall not be visited with evil.
verses.decoded: Respecting the Lord leads to life, and those who do so will be content and protected from harm.

verses.kjv: A slothful man hideth his hand in his bosom, and will not so much as bring it to his mouth again.
verses.decoded: A lazy person keeps their hand hidden and won’t even bring it back to their mouth to eat.

verses.kjv: Smite a scorner, and the simple will beware: and reprove one that hath understanding, and he will understand knowledge.
verses.decoded: Punish a mocker, and the naive will learn to be careful; correct the wise, and they will gain more understanding.

verses.kjv: He that wasteth his father, and chaseth away his mother, is a son that causeth shame, and bringeth reproach.
verses.decoded: A son who mistreats his father and drives away his mother brings shame and disgrace.

verses.kjv: Cease, my son, to hear the instruction that causeth to err from the words of knowledge.
verses.decoded: Stop listening to teaching that leads you away from true knowledge.

verses.kjv: An ungodly witness scorneth judgment: and the mouth of the wicked devoureth iniquity.
verses.decoded: A wicked witness mocks justice, and the words of the wicked spread wrongdoing.

verses.kjv: Judgments are prepared for scorners, and stripes for the back of fools.
verses.decoded: Punishments are ready for mockers, and lashes for fools.

verses.kjv: Wine is a mocker, strong drink is raging: and whosoever is deceived thereby is not wise.
verses.decoded: Wine makes people act foolishly, and strong drink causes anger; anyone who is fooled by them lacks wisdom.

verses.kjv: The fear of a king is as the roaring of a lion: whoso provoketh him to anger sinneth against his own soul.
verses.decoded: Respecting a king is like fearing a roaring lion; anyone who angers him harms themselves.

verses.kjv: It is an honour for a man to cease from strife: but every fool will be meddling.
verses.decoded: It is honorable to avoid arguments, but fools always interfere.

verses.kjv: The sluggard will not plow by reason of the cold; therefore shall he beg in harvest, and have nothing.
verses.decoded: A lazy person won’t work because it’s cold, so when harvest time comes, they will have nothing and must beg.

verses.kjv: Counsel in the heart of man is like deep water; but a man of understanding will draw it out.
verses.decoded: Advice and plans in a person’s heart are like deep water, but a wise person can uncover and understand them.

verses.kjv: Most men will proclaim every one his own goodness: but a faithful man who can find?
verses.decoded: Many people boast about their own goodness, but it’s hard to find someone truly faithful.

verses.kjv: The just man walketh in his integrity: his children are blessed after him.
verses.decoded: A righteous person lives honestly, and their children are blessed because of it.

verses.kjv: A king that sitteth in the throne of judgment scattereth away all evil with his eyes.
verses.decoded: A king who judges fairly can eliminate evil just by looking firmly.

verses.kjv: Who can say, I have made my heart clean, I am pure from my sin?
verses.decoded: Who can honestly say, ‘My heart is pure and I am free from sin’?

verses.kjv: Divers weights, and divers measures, both of them are alike abomination to the LORD.
verses.decoded: Using dishonest weights and measures is equally detestable to the Lord.

verses.kjv: Even a child is known by his doings, whether his work be pure, and whether it be right.
verses.decoded: You can tell a child’s character by their actions, whether they do what is right.

verses.kjv: The hearing ear, and the seeing eye, the LORD hath made even both of them.
verses.decoded: The Lord made both the ear to hear and the eye to see.

verses.kjv: Love not sleep, lest thou come to poverty; open thine eyes, and thou shalt be satisfied with bread.
verses.decoded: Don’t love sleep too much or you will become poor; stay awake and you will have enough to eat.

verses.kjv: It is naught, it is naught, saith the buyer: but when he is gone his way, then he boasteth.
verses.decoded: The buyer says, ‘It’s worthless, it’s worthless,’ but after leaving, he brags about his purchase.

verses.kjv: There is gold, and a multitude of rubies: but the lips of knowledge are a precious jewel.
verses.decoded: Gold and many rubies are valuable, but wise words are a priceless treasure.

verses.kjv: Take his garment that is surety for a stranger: and take a pledge of him for a strange woman.
verses.decoded: Take a person's coat as security when they guarantee a stranger's debt, and take a pledge from someone who is involved with an unfamiliar woman.

verses.kjv: Bread of deceit is sweet to a man; but afterwards his mouth shall be filled with gravel.
verses.decoded: Dishonest gain seems pleasant at first, but in the end it brings bitterness and trouble.

verses.kjv: Every purpose is established by counsel: and with good advice make war.
verses.decoded: Plans succeed when made with good advice; seek wise counsel before taking action, even in conflict.

verses.kjv: He that goeth about as a talebearer revealeth secrets: therefore meddle not with him that flattereth with his lips.
verses.decoded: A gossip spreads secrets; so don’t get involved with someone who flatters you just to manipulate.

verses.kjv: Whoso curseth his father or his mother, his lamp shall be put out in obscure darkness.
verses.decoded: Anyone who curses their parents will face a life of deep darkness and loss.

verses.kjv: An inheritance may be gotten hastily at the beginning; but the end thereof shall not be blessed.
verses.decoded: Getting an inheritance quickly may seem good at first, but it often leads to problems later.

verses.kjv: Say not thou, I will recompense evil; but wait on the LORD, and he shall save thee.
verses.decoded: Don’t say you’ll repay evil with evil; instead, trust God to deliver you.

verses.kjv: Divers weights are an abomination unto the LORD; and a false balance is not good.
verses.decoded: Using dishonest weights and measures is hateful to God; fairness is required.

verses.kjv: Man’s goings are of the LORD; how can a man then understand his own way?
verses.decoded: The LORD directs a person’s steps, so how can anyone fully understand their own path?

verses.kjv: It is a snare to the man who devoureth that which is holy, and after vows to make enquiry.
verses.decoded: It traps a person to take what is sacred and then try to fix it later by making promises.

verses.kjv: A wise king scattereth the wicked, and bringeth the wheel over them.
verses.decoded: A wise ruler defeats the wicked and crushes their power completely.

verses.kjv: The spirit of man is the candle of the LORD, searching all the inward parts of the belly.
verses.decoded: The human spirit is like God’s lamp, examining the deepest parts of a person’s being.

verses.kjv: Mercy and truth preserve the king: and his throne is upholden by mercy.
verses.decoded: Kindness and honesty protect a ruler, and mercy supports his reign.

verses.kjv: The glory of young men is their strength: and the beauty of old men is the grey head.
verses.decoded: Young men are honored for their strength, while old men are respected for their gray hair.

verses.kjv: The blueness of a wound cleanseth away evil: so do stripes the inward parts of the belly.
verses.decoded: The bruises from a wound can heal and remove sickness, just as punishment can cleanse the inner self.

verses.kjv: The king’s heart is in the hand of the LORD, as the rivers of water: he turneth it whithersoever he will.
verses.decoded: God controls the thoughts and decisions of a king like a river is directed by its course; He guides them wherever He chooses.

verses.kjv: Every way of a man is right in his own eyes: but the LORD pondereth the hearts.
verses.decoded: Everyone thinks their own actions are right, but God carefully examines their true motives.

verses.kjv: To do justice and judgment is more acceptable to the LORD than sacrifice.
verses.decoded: God prefers that we act justly and fairly rather than merely offering sacrifices.

verses.kjv: An high look, and a proud heart, and the plowing of the wicked, is sin.
verses.decoded: Arrogance, pride, and the efforts of the wicked are sinful.

verses.kjv: The thoughts of the diligent tend only to plenteousness; but of every one that is hasty only to want.
verses.decoded: Hardworking people plan carefully and gain abundance, but those who rush end up lacking.

verses.kjv: The getting of treasures by a lying tongue is a vanity tossed to and fro of them that seek death.
verses.decoded: Gaining wealth through lies is worthless and leads those who pursue it toward destruction.

verses.kjv: The robbery of the wicked shall destroy them; because they refuse to do judgment.
verses.decoded: The wicked who steal will be ruined because they refuse to act justly.

verses.kjv: The way of man is froward and strange: but as for the pure, his work is right.
verses.decoded: People often act stubbornly and strangely, but those who are pure do what is right.

verses.kjv: It is better to dwell in a corner of the housetop, than with a brawling woman in a wide house.
verses.decoded: It's better to live alone in a small space than to live with a quarrelsome woman in a large house.

verses.kjv: The soul of the wicked desireth evil: his neighbour findeth no favour in his eyes.
verses.decoded: The wicked person wants to do harm and does not show kindness to their neighbor.

verses.kjv: When the scorner is punished, the simple is made wise: and when the wise is instructed, he receiveth knowledge.
verses.decoded: When a mocker is corrected, even simple people learn; and the wise gain more understanding when taught.

verses.kjv: The righteous man wisely considereth the house of the wicked: but God overthroweth the wicked for their wickedness.
verses.decoded: The righteous carefully observe the wicked, but God will destroy the wicked because of their evil.

verses.kjv: Whoso stoppeth his ears at the cry of the poor, he also shall cry himself, but shall not be heard.
verses.decoded: Anyone who ignores the cries of the poor will one day cry out for help but receive no answer.

verses.kjv: A gift in secret pacifieth anger: and a reward in the bosom strong wrath.
verses.decoded: A secret gift can calm anger, and a hidden bribe can stop strong anger.

verses.kjv: It is joy to the just to do judgment: but destruction shall be to the workers of iniquity.
verses.decoded: The righteous find joy in doing what is right, but those who do wrong face destruction.

verses.kjv: The man that wandereth out of the way of understanding shall remain in the congregation of the dead.
verses.decoded: Anyone who strays from the path of understanding will end up among the dead.

verses.kjv: He that loveth pleasure shall be a poor man: he that loveth wine and oil shall not be rich.
verses.decoded: Those who love pleasure will become poor; those who enjoy wine and fine oils won’t become wealthy.

verses.kjv: The wicked shall be a ransom for the righteous, and the transgressor for the upright.
verses.decoded: The wicked will pay the price for the righteous, and sinners will suffer instead of the honest.

verses.kjv: It is better to dwell in the wilderness, than with a contentious and an angry woman.
verses.decoded: It’s better to live alone in the desert than with a quarrelsome and angry woman.

verses.kjv: There is treasure to be desired and oil in the dwelling of the wise; but a foolish man spendeth it up.
verses.decoded: Wise people store up valuable treasures and resources, but fools waste everything they have.

verses.kjv: He that followeth after righteousness and mercy findeth life, righteousness, and honour.
verses.decoded: Those who pursue righteousness and kindness will find life, justice, and respect.

verses.kjv: A wise man scaleth the city of the mighty, and casteth down the strength of the confidence thereof.
verses.decoded: A wise person can conquer a powerful city and destroy its proud defenses.

verses.kjv: Whoso keepeth his mouth and his tongue keepeth his soul from troubles.
verses.decoded: Anyone who controls what they say protects themselves from trouble.

verses.kjv: Proud and haughty scorner is his name, who dealeth in proud wrath.
verses.decoded: A proud and arrogant person is known for their angry and scornful attitude.

verses.kjv: The desire of the slothful killeth him; for his hands refuse to labour.
verses.decoded: The lazy person’s own desires destroy them because they refuse to work.

verses.kjv: He coveteth greedily all the day long: but the righteous giveth and spareth not.
verses.decoded: A greedy person always wants more, but a righteous person gives generously without holding back.

verses.kjv: The sacrifice of the wicked is abomination: how much more, when he bringeth it with a wicked mind?
verses.decoded: The sacrifices of the wicked are detestable, especially when offered with evil intentions.

verses.kjv: A false witness shall perish: but the man that heareth speaketh constantly.
verses.decoded: A false witness will be destroyed, but a person who listens carefully will keep speaking wisely.

verses.kjv: A wicked man hardeneth his face: but as for the upright, he directeth his way.
verses.decoded: A wicked person is stubborn and unyielding, but the honest person carefully plans their path.

verses.kjv: There is no wisdom nor understanding nor counsel against the LORD.
verses.decoded: No wisdom, understanding, or advice can stand against the Lord’s will.

verses.kjv: The horse is prepared against the day of battle: but safety is of the LORD.
verses.decoded: People prepare their horses for battle, but true safety and victory come from the Lord.

verses.kjv: A GOOD name is rather to be chosen than great riches, and loving favour rather than silver and gold.
verses.decoded: Having a good reputation is more valuable than having great wealth, and being well-liked is better than silver or gold.

verses.kjv: The rich and poor meet together: the LORD is the maker of them all.
verses.decoded: Rich and poor people come together, but the LORD is the creator of everyone.

verses.kjv: A prudent man foreseeth the evil, and hideth himself: but the simple pass on, and are punished.
verses.decoded: A wise person sees danger ahead and avoids it, but a naive person ignores it and suffers the consequences.

verses.kjv: By humility and the fear of the LORD are riches, and honour, and life.
verses.decoded: Humility and respect for the LORD bring wealth, honor, and a fulfilling life.

verses.kjv: Thorns and snares are in the way of the froward: he that doth keep his soul shall be far from them.
verses.decoded: Trouble and traps lie in the path of the stubborn, but those who protect themselves stay away from them.

verses.kjv: Train up a child in the way he should go: and when he is old, he will not depart from it.
verses.decoded: Teach a child the right way to live, and they will follow it even when they grow up.

verses.kjv: The rich ruleth over the poor, and the borrower is servant to the lender.
verses.decoded: The wealthy have power over the poor, and anyone who borrows becomes a servant to the lender.

verses.kjv: He that soweth iniquity shall reap vanity: and the rod of his anger shall fail.
verses.decoded: Those who do wrong will gain nothing lasting, and their anger will bring them no success.

verses.kjv: He that hath a bountiful eye shall be blessed; for he giveth of his bread to the poor.
verses.decoded: A generous person will be blessed because they share their food with the poor.

verses.kjv: Cast out the scorner, and contention shall go out; yea, strife and reproach shall cease.
verses.decoded: Remove the mocker, and arguments, fights, and insults will stop.

verses.kjv: He that loveth pureness of heart, for the grace of his lips the king shall be his friend.
verses.decoded: Those who love sincerity and speak graciously will gain the friendship of the king.

verses.kjv: The eyes of the LORD preserve knowledge, and he overthroweth the words of the transgressor.
verses.decoded: The LORD watches over true knowledge and defeats the plans of those who break the law.

verses.kjv: The slothful man saith, There is a lion without, I shall be slain in the streets.
verses.decoded: A lazy person makes excuses, saying, 'There's a lion outside; I will be killed in the streets.'

verses.kjv: The mouth of strange women is a deep pit: he that is abhorred of the LORD shall fall therein.
verses.decoded: The words of immoral women are like a deep trap; those rejected by the LORD will fall into it.

verses.kjv: Foolishness is bound in the heart of a child; but the rod of correction shall drive it far from him.
verses.decoded: Children naturally have foolishness in their hearts, but discipline will help remove it.

verses.kjv: He that oppresseth the poor to increase his riches, and he that giveth to the rich, shall surely come to want.
verses.decoded: Anyone who mistreats the poor to get richer, or gives to the rich expecting something in return, will end up in need.

verses.kjv: Bow down thine ear, and hear the words of the wise, and apply thine heart unto my knowledge.
verses.decoded: Listen carefully to the advice of the wise and pay close attention to what I teach.

verses.kjv: For it is a pleasant thing if thou keep them within thee; they shall withal be fitted in thy lips.
verses.decoded: It is good to keep these teachings inside you; they will naturally come out when you speak.

verses.kjv: That thy trust may be in the LORD, I have made known to thee this day, even to thee.
verses.decoded: I have shared this with you today so that you can put your trust in the LORD.

verses.kjv: Have not I written to thee excellent things in counsels and knowledge,
verses.decoded: Haven't I already given you valuable advice and knowledge in writing?

verses.kjv: That I might make thee know the certainty of the words of truth; that thou mightest answer the words of truth to them that send unto thee?
verses.decoded: So you can understand the truth clearly and confidently respond to those who ask you for guidance.

verses.kjv: Rob not the poor, because he is poor: neither oppress the afflicted in the gate:
verses.decoded: Don’t take advantage of the poor just because they are poor, and don’t mistreat those who are vulnerable in public places.

verses.kjv: For the LORD will plead their cause, and spoil the soul of those that spoiled them.
verses.decoded: The LORD will defend the poor and punish those who harm them.

verses.kjv: Make no friendship with an angry man; and with a furious man thou shalt not go:
verses.decoded: Don’t become friends with someone quick to anger or spend time with someone who is easily enraged.

verses.kjv: Lest thou learn his ways, and get a snare to thy soul.
verses.decoded: Otherwise, you might start acting like them and trap yourself in trouble.

verses.kjv: Be not thou one of them that strike hands, or of them that are sureties for debts.
verses.decoded: Don’t agree to guarantee someone else’s debt or make promises you might not be able to keep.

verses.kjv: If thou hast nothing to pay, why should he take away thy bed from under thee?
verses.decoded: If you can’t pay what you owe, why risk losing even your basic necessities?

verses.kjv: Remove not the ancient landmark, which thy fathers have set.
verses.decoded: Don’t move the old boundary markers that your ancestors established.

verses.kjv: Seest thou a man diligent in his business? he shall stand before kings; he shall not stand before mean men.
verses.decoded: If you see someone hardworking and careful in their work, they will gain respect and stand before important people, not ordinary ones.

verses.kjv: When thou sittest to eat with a ruler, consider diligently what is before thee:
verses.decoded: When you eat with a leader, pay close attention to what is in front of you.

verses.kjv: And put a knife to thy throat, if thou be a man given to appetite.
verses.decoded: If you have a strong appetite, be very careful not to overindulge.

verses.kjv: Be not desirous of his dainties: for they are deceitful meat.
verses.decoded: Don’t crave the rich food he offers, because it can be deceptive or harmful.

verses.kjv: Labour not to be rich: cease from thine own wisdom.
verses.decoded: Don’t work just to get rich; stop relying only on your own cleverness.

verses.kjv: Wilt thou set thine eyes upon that which is not? for riches certainly make themselves wings; they fly away as an eagle toward heaven.
verses.decoded: Why focus on wealth that isn’t secure? Riches can disappear quickly, like an eagle flying away.

verses.kjv: Eat thou not the bread of him that hath an evil eye, neither desire thou his dainty meats:
verses.decoded: Don’t accept food from someone who is jealous or stingy, and don’t want their fancy dishes.

verses.kjv: For as he thinketh in his heart, so is he: Eat and drink, saith he to thee; but his heart is not with thee.
verses.decoded: A person’s true feelings show who they are; they may invite you to eat and drink, but they don’t truly care about you.

verses.kjv: The morsel which thou hast eaten shalt thou vomit up, and lose thy sweet words.
verses.decoded: You might regret accepting their food, and your kind words will be wasted.

verses.kjv: Speak not in the ears of a fool: for he will despise the wisdom of thy words.
verses.decoded: Don’t waste your words on a fool; they will reject your wise advice.

verses.kjv: Remove not the old landmark; and enter not into the fields of the fatherless:
verses.decoded: Don’t move the boundary markers or take land that belongs to orphans.

verses.kjv: For their redeemer is mighty; he shall plead their cause with thee.
verses.decoded: Their protector is powerful and will defend their rights against you.

verses.kjv: Apply thine heart unto instruction, and thine ears to the words of knowledge.
verses.decoded: Focus your heart on learning and listen carefully to wise teaching.

verses.kjv: Withhold not correction from the child: for if thou beatest him with the rod, he shall not die.
verses.decoded: Don’t hold back discipline from a child; using correction won’t kill them.

verses.kjv: Thou shalt beat him with the rod, and shalt deliver his soul from hell.
verses.decoded: Disciplining a child can save them from a life of destruction.

verses.kjv: My son, if thine heart be wise, my heart shall rejoice, even mine.
verses.decoded: My child, if you have wisdom in your heart, it will make me very happy.

verses.kjv: Yea, my reins shall rejoice, when thy lips speak right things.
verses.decoded: Yes, my innermost being will be glad when you speak what is right.

verses.kjv: Let not thine heart envy sinners: but be thou in the fear of the LORD all the day long.
verses.decoded: Don't let your heart envy those who do wrong; instead, always respect and honor the Lord.

verses.kjv: For surely there is an end; and thine expectation shall not be cut off.
verses.decoded: There is definitely a future reward, and your hope will not be disappointed.

verses.kjv: Hear thou, my son, and be wise, and guide thine heart in the way.
verses.decoded: Listen carefully, my son, be wise, and direct your heart to follow the right path.

verses.kjv: Be not among winebibbers; among riotous eaters of flesh:
verses.decoded: Don't join those who drink too much wine or indulge in excessive eating.

verses.kjv: For the drunkard and the glutton shall come to poverty: and drowsiness shall clothe a man with rags.
verses.decoded: Those who are drunkards and gluttons will become poor, and laziness will leave them in rags.

verses.kjv: Hearken unto thy father that begat thee, and despise not thy mother when she is old.
verses.decoded: Listen to your father who gave you life, and don't disrespect your mother when she is old.

verses.kjv: Buy the truth, and sell it not; also wisdom, and instruction, and understanding.
verses.decoded: Seek truth and never give it up; also pursue wisdom, teaching, and understanding.

verses.kjv: The father of the righteous shall greatly rejoice: and he that begetteth a wise child shall have joy of him.
verses.decoded: A father will be very happy when his child is righteous and wise.

verses.kjv: Thy father and thy mother shall be glad, and she that bare thee shall rejoice.
verses.decoded: Your father and mother will be glad, and the woman who gave birth to you will rejoice.

verses.kjv: My son, give me thine heart, and let thine eyes observe my ways.
verses.decoded: My son, give me your full attention and watch closely how I live.

verses.kjv: For a whore is a deep ditch; and a strange woman is a narrow pit.
verses.decoded: An immoral woman is like a deep hole, and a woman who is not your own is like a narrow trap.

verses.kjv: She also lieth in wait as for a prey, and increaseth the transgressors among men.
verses.decoded: She waits to trap victims and leads many people into sin.

verses.kjv: Who hath woe? who hath sorrow? who hath contentions? who hath babbling? who hath wounds without cause? who hath redness of eyes?
verses.decoded: Who suffers pain, sorrow, fights, gossip, unexplained wounds, or red eyes?

verses.kjv: They that tarry long at the wine; they that go to seek mixed wine.
verses.decoded: Those who stay too long drinking wine and look for strong alcoholic drinks.

verses.kjv: Look not thou upon the wine when it is red, when it giveth his colour in the cup, when it moveth itself aright.
verses.decoded: Don't stare at wine just because it's red and looks appealing in the cup when it swirls smoothly.

verses.kjv: At the last it biteth like a serpent, and stingeth like an adder.
verses.decoded: In the end, it bites like a snake and stings like a poisonous serpent.

verses.kjv: Thine eyes shall behold strange women, and thine heart shall utter perverse things.
verses.decoded: Your eyes will see strange women, and your heart will say foolish and wrong things.

verses.kjv: Yea, thou shalt be as he that lieth down in the midst of the sea, or as he that lieth upon the top of a mast.
verses.decoded: You will feel like someone lying in the middle of the sea or on top of a ship's mast, unstable and helpless.

verses.kjv: They have stricken me, shalt thou say, and I was not sick; they have beaten me, and I felt it not: when shall I awake? I will seek it yet again.
verses.decoded: You might say, 'They hit me, but I didn't feel sick; they beat me, but I didn't notice. When will I wake up? I'll try it again.'

verses.kjv: Be not thou envious against evil men, neither desire to be with them.
verses.decoded: Don't be jealous of wicked people, and don't want to hang out with them.

verses.kjv: For their heart studieth destruction, and their lips talk of mischief.
verses.decoded: Their minds plan harm, and their words speak of trouble.

verses.kjv: Through wisdom is an house builded; and by understanding it is established:
verses.decoded: A house is built through wisdom, and it is made strong through understanding.

verses.kjv: And by knowledge shall the chambers be filled with all precious and pleasant riches.
verses.decoded: With knowledge, the rooms are filled with valuable and beautiful things.

verses.kjv: A wise man is strong; yea, a man of knowledge increaseth strength.
verses.decoded: A wise person is powerful; having knowledge makes you even stronger.

verses.kjv: For by wise counsel thou shalt make thy war: and in multitude of counsellors there is safety.
verses.decoded: You win battles by planning wisely, and having many advisors brings safety.

verses.kjv: Wisdom is too high for a fool: he openeth not his mouth in the gate.
verses.decoded: Wisdom is beyond a fool’s reach; fools stay silent in public places.

verses.kjv: He that deviseth to do evil shall be called a mischievous person.
verses.decoded: Anyone who plans evil will be known as troublemaker.

verses.kjv: The thought of foolishness is sin: and the scorner is an abomination to men.
verses.decoded: Foolish thoughts are sinful, and people hate those who mock others.

verses.kjv: If thou faint in the day of adversity, thy strength is small.
verses.decoded: If you give up when trouble comes, your strength is weak.

verses.kjv: If thou forbear to deliver them that are drawn unto death, and those that are ready to be slain;
verses.decoded: If you refuse to help those who are about to die or be killed,

verses.kjv: If thou sayest, Behold, we knew it not; doth not he that pondereth the heart consider it? and he that keepeth thy soul, doth not he know it? and shall not he render to every man according to his works?
verses.decoded: If you say, 'We didn’t know,' God who examines hearts knows, and He will judge everyone according to what they do.

verses.kjv: My son, eat thou honey, because it is good; and the honeycomb, which is sweet to thy taste:
verses.decoded: My child, eat honey because it is good, and enjoy the sweetness of honeycomb.

verses.kjv: So shall the knowledge of wisdom be unto thy soul: when thou hast found it, then there shall be a reward, and thy expectation shall not be cut off.
verses.decoded: The knowledge of wisdom will nourish your soul; when you find it, you will be rewarded and your hopes won’t be disappointed.

verses.kjv: Lay not wait, O wicked man, against the dwelling of the righteous; spoil not his resting place:
verses.decoded: Don’t set traps for good people or harm where they live and rest.

verses.kjv: For a just man falleth seven times, and riseth up again: but the wicked shall fall into mischief.
verses.decoded: A righteous person may fall down seven times but will get up again; however, the wicked will stumble into trouble and stay down.

verses.kjv: Rejoice not when thine enemy falleth, and let not thine heart be glad when he stumbleth:
verses.decoded: Don’t celebrate when your enemy falls or feel happy when they trip up.

verses.kjv: Lest the LORD see it, and it displease him, and he turn away his wrath from him.
verses.decoded: Because the Lord might see it, be displeased, and stop punishing your enemy.

verses.kjv: Fret not thyself because of evil men, neither be thou envious at the wicked;
verses.decoded: Don’t get upset or jealous because of evil people or the wicked.

verses.kjv: For there shall be no reward to the evil man; the candle of the wicked shall be put out.
verses.decoded: Evil people will not be rewarded; the light of the wicked will be extinguished.

verses.kjv: My son, fear thou the LORD and the king: and meddle not with them that are given to change:
verses.decoded: My son, respect and honor the Lord and the king; don’t get involved with people who are always causing trouble or changing loyalties.

verses.kjv: For their calamity shall rise suddenly; and who knoweth the ruin of them both?
verses.decoded: Their disaster will come suddenly, and no one knows when both the Lord’s and the king’s judgment will fall.

verses.kjv: These things also belong to the wise. It is not good to have respect of persons in judgment.
verses.decoded: These are also wise principles: it’s wrong to show favoritism when judging others.

verses.kjv: He that saith unto the wicked, Thou art righteous; him shall the people curse, nations shall abhor him:
verses.decoded: Anyone who tells a wicked person they are right will be cursed by the people and hated by nations.

verses.kjv: But to them that rebuke him shall be delight, and a good blessing shall come upon them.
verses.decoded: But those who correct the wicked will find joy and receive a good blessing.

verses.kjv: Every man shall kiss his lips that giveth a right answer.
verses.decoded: People will respect and appreciate anyone who gives a truthful and wise answer.

verses.kjv: Prepare thy work without, and make it fit for thyself in the field; and afterwards build thine house.
verses.decoded: Plan and complete your work outside first, get everything ready in the field, then build your house.

verses.kjv: Be not a witness against thy neighbour without cause; and deceive not with thy lips.
verses.decoded: Don’t give false testimony against your neighbor or lie with your words.

verses.kjv: Say not, I will do so to him as he hath done to me: I will render to the man according to his work.
verses.decoded: Don’t say, ‘I’ll treat him the same way he treated me’ or ‘I’ll repay him for what he did.’

verses.kjv: I went by the field of the slothful, and by the vineyard of the man void of understanding;
verses.decoded: I passed by the field of a lazy person and the vineyard of someone who lacks understanding.

verses.kjv: And, lo, it was all grown over with thorns, and nettles had covered the face thereof, and the stone wall thereof was broken down.
verses.decoded: Look, the vineyard was completely overgrown with thorns and nettles, and its stone wall was broken down.

verses.kjv: Then I saw, and considered it well: I looked upon it, and received instruction.
verses.decoded: Then I observed it carefully and thought deeply about it; I paid attention and learned a lesson.

verses.kjv: Yet a little sleep, a little slumber, a little folding of the hands to sleep:
verses.decoded: But a little sleep, a little rest, just folding your hands to relax for a moment,

verses.kjv: So shall thy poverty come as one that travelleth; and thy want as an armed man.
verses.decoded: Then poverty will come on you suddenly, like a traveler, and scarcity will attack you like a warrior armed for battle.

verses.kjv: These are also proverbs of Solomon, which the men of Hezekiah king of Judah copied out.
verses.decoded: These are additional proverbs of Solomon that were copied by the officials of King Hezekiah of Judah.

verses.kjv: It is the glory of God to conceal a thing: but the honour of kings is to search out a matter.
verses.decoded: It brings God glory to keep some things hidden, but it is the duty and honor of kings to investigate and understand matters.

verses.kjv: The heaven for height, and the earth for depth, and the heart of kings is unsearchable.
verses.decoded: The sky is vast in height, the earth is deep, and the thoughts of kings are impossible to fully understand.

verses.kjv: Take away the dross from the silver, and there shall come forth a vessel for the finer.
verses.decoded: Remove the impurities from silver, and a valuable object will be revealed for the silversmith.

verses.kjv: Take away the wicked from before the king, and his throne shall be established in righteousness.
verses.decoded: Remove evil people from the king’s presence, and his reign will be firmly based on justice.

verses.kjv: Put not forth thyself in the presence of the king, and stand not in the place of great men:
verses.decoded: Don’t try to promote yourself or take a place of honor in front of the king or important people.

verses.kjv: For better it is that it be said unto thee, Come up hither; than that thou shouldest be put lower in the presence of the prince whom thine eyes have seen.
verses.decoded: It’s better to be invited to move up to a higher position than to be embarrassed by being told to move down in front of a ruler you have seen.

verses.kjv: Go not forth hastily to strive, lest thou know not what to do in the end thereof, when thy neighbour hath put thee to shame.
verses.decoded: Don’t rush into an argument before you understand the situation, or you might be embarrassed by your opponent later.

verses.kjv: Debate thy cause with thy neighbour himself; and discover not a secret to another:
verses.decoded: Discuss your dispute directly with your neighbor and don’t reveal private matters to others.

verses.kjv: Lest he that heareth it put thee to shame, and thine infamy turn not away.
verses.decoded: Otherwise, the person who hears it might embarrass you, and your bad reputation won’t be erased.

verses.kjv: A word fitly spoken is like apples of gold in pictures of silver.
verses.decoded: A well-timed, appropriate word is as beautiful and valuable as golden apples set in silver frames.

verses.kjv: As an earring of gold, and an ornament of fine gold, so is a wise reprover upon an obedient ear.
verses.decoded: A wise correction is like a beautiful gold earring or fine jewelry to someone who listens willingly.

verses.kjv: As the cold of snow in the time of harvest, so is a faithful messenger to them that send him: for he refresheth the soul of his masters.
verses.decoded: Like cold snow during harvest time, a reliable messenger brings refreshing relief to those who send him.

verses.kjv: Whoso boasteth himself of a false gift is like clouds and wind without rain.
verses.decoded: Anyone who brags about a gift that isn’t real is like clouds and wind that bring no rain.

verses.kjv: By long forbearing is a prince persuaded, and a soft tongue breaketh the bone.
verses.decoded: A patient attitude can persuade a ruler, and gentle words can overcome the hardest resistance.

verses.kjv: Hast thou found honey? eat so much as is sufficient for thee, lest thou be filled therewith, and vomit it.
verses.decoded: If you find honey, eat only as much as you need, or you might eat too much and feel sick.

verses.kjv: Withdraw thy foot from thy neighbour’s house; lest he be weary of thee, and so hate thee.
verses.decoded: Don't visit your neighbor's house too often, or they might get tired of you and start to dislike you.

verses.kjv: A man that beareth false witness against his neighbour is a maul, and a sword, and a sharp arrow.
verses.decoded: Someone who lies about their neighbor is like a hammer, a sword, or a sharp arrow—tools that cause serious harm.

verses.kjv: Confidence in an unfaithful man in time of trouble is like a broken tooth, and a foot out of joint.
verses.decoded: Trusting someone unreliable when you're in trouble is like having a broken tooth or a dislocated foot—it's painful and unhelpful.

verses.kjv: As he that taketh away a garment in cold weather, and as vinegar upon nitre, so is he that singeth songs to an heavy heart.
verses.decoded: Taking away a coat on a cold day or putting vinegar on baking soda is like singing happy songs to someone who is sad—it just doesn't help.

verses.kjv: If thine enemy be hungry, give him bread to eat; and if he be thirsty, give him water to drink:
verses.decoded: If your enemy is hungry, feed them; if they are thirsty, give them something to drink.

verses.kjv: For thou shalt heap coals of fire upon his head, and the LORD shall reward thee.
verses.decoded: By doing this, you will make them feel ashamed, and God will reward you.

verses.kjv: The north wind driveth away rain: so doth an angry countenance a backbiting tongue.
verses.decoded: Just as the north wind drives away rain, an angry face can stop gossip and slander.

verses.kjv: It is better to dwell in the corner of the housetop, than with a brawling woman and in a wide house.
verses.decoded: It's better to live in a small, uncomfortable place than with a quarrelsome woman in a large house.

verses.kjv: As cold waters to a thirsty soul, so is good news from a far country.
verses.decoded: Good news from far away is like cold water to someone who is very thirsty.

verses.kjv: A righteous man falling down before the wicked is as a troubled fountain, and a corrupt spring.
verses.decoded: When a good person gives in to evil people, it's like a polluted spring or a muddy fountain.

verses.kjv: It is not good to eat much honey: so for men to search their own glory is not glory.
verses.decoded: Eating too much honey is bad, and so is trying too hard to praise yourself.

verses.kjv: He that hath no rule over his own spirit is like a city that is broken down, and without walls.
verses.decoded: Someone who can't control their emotions is like a city with broken walls—vulnerable to attack.

verses.kjv: As snow in summer, and as rain in harvest, so honour is not seemly for a fool.
verses.decoded: Honoring a fool is as out of place as snow in the summer or rain during harvest time.

verses.kjv: As the bird by wandering, as the swallow by flying, so the curse causeless shall not come.
verses.decoded: Just as birds don’t wander without purpose and swallows don’t fly aimlessly, a curse without a cause will not happen.

verses.kjv: A whip for the horse, a bridle for the ass, and a rod for the fool’s back.
verses.decoded: Horses need a whip, donkeys need a bridle, and fools need discipline.

verses.kjv: Answer not a fool according to his folly, lest thou also be like unto him.
verses.decoded: Don’t respond to a fool’s foolishness in the same way, or you will become like him.

verses.kjv: Answer a fool according to his folly, lest he be wise in his own conceit.
verses.decoded: But sometimes you must respond to a fool’s foolishness so he doesn’t think he is wise.

verses.kjv: He that sendeth a message by the hand of a fool cutteth off the feet, and drinketh damage.
verses.decoded: Sending a message through a fool is like cutting off your own feet and causing harm to yourself.

verses.kjv: The legs of the lame are not equal: so is a parable in the mouth of fools.
verses.decoded: Just as a lame person’s legs don’t work equally well, a proverb from a fool doesn’t make sense.

verses.kjv: As he that bindeth a stone in a sling, so is he that giveth honour to a fool.
verses.decoded: Giving honor to a fool is like putting a stone in a sling—it’s useless and dangerous.

verses.kjv: As a thorn goeth up into the hand of a drunkard, so is a parable in the mouth of fools.
verses.decoded: A parable in a fool’s mouth is like a thorn stuck in a drunkard’s hand—painful and irritating.

verses.kjv: The great God that formed all things both rewardeth the fool, and rewardeth transgressors.
verses.decoded: A powerful person who hires others will employ both fools and wrongdoers.

verses.kjv: As a dog returneth to his vomit, so a fool returneth to his folly.
verses.decoded: Just as a dog goes back to eat its vomit, a fool repeats his foolish mistakes.

verses.kjv: Seest thou a man wise in his own conceit? there is more hope of a fool than of him.
verses.decoded: If you see someone who thinks he is wise but isn’t, there’s more hope for a fool than for him.

verses.kjv: The slothful man saith, There is a lion in the way; a lion is in the streets.
verses.decoded: A lazy person makes excuses, saying there’s a lion blocking the path or in the streets.

verses.kjv: As the door turneth upon his hinges, so doth the slothful upon his bed.
verses.decoded: Just as a door swings back and forth on its hinges, a lazy person rolls around in bed.

verses.kjv: The slothful hideth his hand in his bosom; it grieveth him to bring it again to his mouth.
verses.decoded: A lazy person keeps his hand in his lap because even moving it to his mouth feels like too much work.

verses.kjv: The sluggard is wiser in his own conceit than seven men that can render a reason.
verses.decoded: A lazy person thinks they are smarter than seven people who can give good reasons.

verses.kjv: He that passeth by, and meddleth with strife belonging not to him, is like one that taketh a dog by the ears.
verses.decoded: Someone who gets involved in an argument that doesn't concern them is like grabbing a dog by the ears—it's dangerous and foolish.

verses.kjv: As a mad man who casteth firebrands, arrows, and death,
verses.decoded: Like a crazy person who throws flaming sticks, arrows, and deadly weapons,

verses.kjv: So is the man that deceiveth his neighbour, and saith, Am not I in sport?
verses.decoded: is the person who tricks their neighbor and then says, 'I'm just joking, aren't I?'

verses.kjv: Where no wood is, there the fire goeth out: so where there is no talebearer, the strife ceaseth.
verses.decoded: Without wood, a fire goes out; similarly, without gossipers, arguments stop.

verses.kjv: As coals are to burning coals, and wood to fire; so is a contentious man to kindle strife.
verses.decoded: Just as coals fuel a fire, a quarrelsome person starts fights.

verses.kjv: The words of a talebearer are as wounds, and they go down into the innermost parts of the belly.
verses.decoded: Gossiping words hurt deeply, like wounds that reach the innermost parts of the body.

verses.kjv: Burning lips and a wicked heart are like a potsherd covered with silver dross.
verses.decoded: Fiery words from a wicked heart are like a broken pot covered with shiny silver—looks good on the outside but is worthless inside.

verses.kjv: He that hateth dissembleth with his lips, and layeth up deceit within him;
verses.decoded: A person who hates pretends with their words but hides deceit in their heart.

verses.kjv: When he speaketh fair, believe him not: for there are seven abominations in his heart.
verses.decoded: When someone speaks nicely, don’t trust them—they have many hateful things in their heart.

verses.kjv: Whose hatred is covered by deceit, his wickedness shall be shewed before the whole congregation.
verses.decoded: Someone whose hatred is hidden by lies will have their evil revealed publicly.

verses.kjv: Whoso diggeth a pit shall fall therein: and he that rolleth a stone, it will return upon him.
verses.decoded: Whoever digs a pit will fall into it; whoever rolls a stone will have it roll back on them.

verses.kjv: A lying tongue hateth those that are afflicted by it; and a flattering mouth worketh ruin.
verses.decoded: A lying tongue hates those it hurts, and flattering words cause destruction.

verses.kjv: Boast not thyself of to morrow; for thou knowest not what a day may bring forth.
verses.decoded: Don't brag about tomorrow, because you don't know what the day will bring.

verses.kjv: Let another man praise thee, and not thine own mouth; a stranger, and not thine own lips.
verses.decoded: Let someone else praise you, not yourself; let a stranger, not your own lips, do it.

verses.kjv: A stone is heavy, and the sand weighty; but a fool’s wrath is heavier than them both.
verses.decoded: A stone is heavy, and sand is weighty, but a fool’s anger is even heavier.

verses.kjv: Wrath is cruel, and anger is outrageous; but who is able to stand before envy?
verses.decoded: Anger is cruel and rage is wild, but who can stand against jealousy?

verses.kjv: Open rebuke is better than secret love.
verses.decoded: Honest criticism is better than hidden affection.

verses.kjv: Faithful are the wounds of a friend; but the kisses of an enemy are deceitful.
verses.decoded: The wounds from a true friend are loyal, but an enemy’s kisses are fake.

verses.kjv: The full soul loatheth an honeycomb; but to the hungry soul every bitter thing is sweet.
verses.decoded: A full stomach despises honeycomb, but to a hungry person even bitter food tastes sweet.

verses.kjv: As a bird that wandereth from her nest, so is a man that wandereth from his place.
verses.decoded: Like a bird that leaves its nest, a person who leaves their proper place is lost.

verses.kjv: Ointment and perfume rejoice the heart: so doth the sweetness of a man’s friend by hearty counsel.
verses.decoded: Perfume and ointment make the heart glad; likewise, sincere advice from a friend brings joy.

verses.kjv: Thine own friend, and thy father’s friend, forsake not; neither go into thy brother’s house in the day of thy calamity: for better is a neighbour that is near than a brother far off.
verses.decoded: Don’t abandon your friend or your father’s friend. Don’t rely on your brother’s house when trouble comes; a nearby neighbor is better than a distant relative.

verses.kjv: My son, be wise, and make my heart glad, that I may answer him that reproacheth me.
verses.decoded: My son, be wise and make me happy, so I can respond to those who criticize me.

verses.kjv: A prudent man foreseeth the evil, and hideth himself; but the simple pass on, and are punished.
verses.decoded: A wise person sees danger and avoids it, but a simple person goes ahead and suffers the consequences.

verses.kjv: Take his garment that is surety for a stranger, and take a pledge of him for a strange woman.
verses.decoded: If someone guarantees a stranger’s debt, take their coat as security; do the same if they guarantee a strange woman’s debt.

verses.kjv: He that blesseth his friend with a loud voice, rising early in the morning, it shall be counted a curse to him.
verses.decoded: If you loudly greet your friend early in the morning, it will be like a curse to you.

verses.kjv: A continual dropping in a very rainy day and a contentious woman are alike.
verses.decoded: Constant dripping on a rainy day is like a quarrelsome wife.

verses.kjv: Whosoever hideth her hideth the wind, and the ointment of his right hand, which bewrayeth itself.
verses.decoded: Trying to hold onto her is like trying to hold the wind or the valuable oil on your right hand—it will slip away and reveal itself.

verses.kjv: Iron sharpeneth iron; so a man sharpeneth the countenance of his friend.
verses.decoded: Just as iron sharpens iron, people improve and encourage each other through honest interaction.

verses.kjv: Whoso keepeth the fig tree shall eat the fruit thereof: so he that waiteth on his master shall be honoured.
verses.decoded: Whoever cares for the fig tree will enjoy its fruit; similarly, those who serve their master faithfully will be respected.

verses.kjv: As in water face answereth to face, so the heart of man to man.
verses.decoded: Just as a face is reflected in water, a person's heart is revealed to another person.

verses.kjv: Hell and destruction are never full; so the eyes of man are never satisfied.
verses.decoded: Just as the grave is never full, human desire is never satisfied.

verses.kjv: As the fining pot for silver, and the furnace for gold; so is a man to his praise.
verses.decoded: Just as silver is purified in a refining pot and gold in a furnace, a person is tested by the praise they receive.

verses.kjv: Though thou shouldest bray a fool in a mortar among wheat with a pestle, yet will not his foolishness depart from him.
verses.decoded: Even if you crush a fool like grain in a mortar, his foolishness won’t leave him.

verses.kjv: Be thou diligent to know the state of thy flocks, and look well to thy herds.
verses.decoded: Be careful and attentive in managing your flocks; pay close attention to your herds.

verses.kjv: For riches are not for ever: and doth the crown endure to every generation?
verses.decoded: Wealth does not last forever, and a crown does not pass down through every generation.

verses.kjv: The hay appeareth, and the tender grass sheweth itself, and herbs of the mountains are gathered.
verses.decoded: The hay is cut, the new grass appears, and the herbs from the mountains are collected.

verses.kjv: The lambs are for thy clothing, and the goats are the price of the field.
verses.decoded: Lambs provide you with clothing, and goats are sold to pay for your land.
