verses.kjv: And thou shalt have goats’ milk enough for thy food, for the food of thy household, and for the maintenance for thy maidens.
verses.decoded: You will have enough goat’s milk to feed yourself, your family, and to support your servants.

verses.kjv: The wicked flee when no man pursueth: but the righteous are bold as a lion.
verses.decoded: Evil people run away even when no one is chasing them, but good people are confident and fearless like a lion.

verses.kjv: For the transgression of a land many are the princes thereof: but by a man of understanding and knowledge the state thereof shall be prolonged.
verses.decoded: When a country is full of sin, many leaders will be involved in wrongdoing; but a wise and knowledgeable leader can keep the nation strong and lasting.

verses.kjv: A poor man that oppresseth the poor is like a sweeping rain which leaveth no food.
verses.decoded: A poor person who mistreats other poor people is like a heavy rain that destroys all the crops and leaves nothing to eat.

verses.kjv: They that forsake the law praise the wicked: but such as keep the law contend with them.
verses.decoded: Those who reject God's law support evil people, but those who obey the law oppose them.

verses.kjv: Evil men understand not judgment: but they that seek the LORD understand all things.
verses.decoded: Evil people do not understand what is right, but those who seek God understand everything clearly.

verses.kjv: Better is the poor that walketh in his uprightness, than he that is perverse in his ways, though he be rich.
verses.decoded: It is better to be poor and live honestly than to be rich but live in a corrupt and dishonest way.

verses.kjv: Whoso keepeth the law is a wise son: but he that is a companion of riotous men shameth his father.
verses.decoded: Anyone who obeys the law is a wise child, but anyone who hangs out with wild and reckless people brings shame to their family.

verses.kjv: He that by usury and unjust gain increaseth his substance, he shall gather it for him that will pity the poor.
verses.decoded: Someone who grows rich by charging unfair interest or dishonest means is really collecting wealth to give to those who will help the poor.

verses.kjv: He that turneth away his ear from hearing the law, even his prayer shall be abomination.
verses.decoded: If a person refuses to listen to God's law, their prayers are detestable to God.

verses.kjv: Whoso causeth the righteous to go astray in an evil way, he shall fall himself into his own pit: but the upright shall have good things in possession.
verses.decoded: Anyone who leads good people into evil will end up trapped by their own wrongdoing, but honest people will enjoy blessings.

verses.kjv: The rich man is wise in his own conceit; but the poor that hath understanding searcheth him out.
verses.decoded: A rich person often thinks they are wise, but a poor person with understanding can see through that and learn from them.

verses.kjv: When righteous men do rejoice, there is great glory: but when the wicked rise, a man is hidden.
verses.decoded: When good people succeed, it brings honor; but when evil people gain power, good people often have to hide.

verses.kjv: He that covereth his sins shall not prosper: but whoso confesseth and forsaketh them shall have mercy.
verses.decoded: Anyone who hides their sins will not succeed, but those who admit and turn away from their sins will receive mercy.

verses.kjv: Happy is the man that feareth alway: but he that hardeneth his heart shall fall into mischief.
verses.decoded: Blessed is the person who always respects God; but anyone who refuses to listen will end up in trouble.

verses.kjv: As a roaring lion, and a ranging bear; so is a wicked ruler over the poor people.
verses.decoded: A cruel leader is like a roaring lion or a wandering bear—dangerous and frightening to the poor.

verses.kjv: The prince that wanteth understanding is also a great oppressor: but he that hateth covetousness shall prolong his days.
verses.decoded: A leader who lacks understanding is a harsh oppressor, but one who hates greed will live a longer life.

verses.kjv: A man that doeth violence to the blood of any person shall flee to the pit; let no man stay him.
verses.decoded: Anyone who commits murder will be forced to escape to a grave or ruin, and no one should stop them.

verses.kjv: Whoso walketh uprightly shall be saved: but he that is perverse in his ways shall fall at once.
verses.decoded: Those who live honestly and rightly will be saved, but those who are crooked in their ways will quickly fail.

verses.kjv: He that tilleth his land shall have plenty of bread: but he that followeth after vain persons shall have poverty enough.
verses.decoded: The person who works hard will have plenty to eat, but the one who chases worthless people will end up poor.

verses.kjv: A faithful man shall abound with blessings: but he that maketh haste to be rich shall not be innocent.
verses.decoded: A trustworthy person will receive many blessings, but someone who rushes to get rich will not go unpunished.

verses.kjv: To have respect of persons is not good: for for a piece of bread that man will transgress.
verses.decoded: Showing favoritism is wrong, because some people will do wrong just for a small reward.

verses.kjv: He that hasteth to be rich hath an evil eye, and considereth not that poverty shall come upon him.
verses.decoded: The person eager to get rich quickly is greedy and doesn’t realize that poverty will come upon him.

verses.kjv: He that rebuketh a man afterwards shall find more favour than he that flattereth with the tongue.
verses.decoded: Someone who corrects others honestly will be more respected than someone who only flatters with words.

verses.kjv: Whoso robbeth his father or his mother, and saith, It is no transgression; the same is the companion of a destroyer.
verses.decoded: Anyone who steals from their parents and claims it’s not wrong is like a partner with a destroyer.

verses.kjv: He that is of a proud heart stirreth up strife: but he that putteth his trust in the LORD shall be made fat.
verses.decoded: A proud person causes conflict, but those who trust in the Lord will be well cared for and satisfied.

verses.kjv: He that trusteth in his own heart is a fool: but whoso walketh wisely, he shall be delivered.
verses.decoded: Anyone who trusts only in their own understanding is foolish, but the wise person will be saved.

verses.kjv: He that giveth unto the poor shall not lack: but he that hideth his eyes shall have many a curse.
verses.decoded: Those who give to the poor will never be in need, but those who ignore them will face many troubles.

verses.kjv: When the wicked rise, men hide themselves: but when they perish, the righteous increase.
verses.decoded: When evil people gain power, others hide in fear; but when they are gone, the good people thrive.

verses.kjv: He, that being often reproved hardeneth his neck, shall suddenly be destroyed, and that without remedy.
verses.decoded: Anyone who refuses to listen to correction and stubbornly resists will be suddenly destroyed, with no chance to recover.

verses.kjv: When the righteous are in authority, the people rejoice: but when the wicked beareth rule, the people mourn.
verses.decoded: When good and honest leaders are in charge, the people are happy; but when evil leaders rule, the people suffer.

verses.kjv: Whoso loveth wisdom rejoiceth his father: but he that keepeth company with harlots spendeth his substance.
verses.decoded: Anyone who loves wisdom makes their father proud, but those who hang out with immoral people waste their resources.

verses.kjv: The king by judgment establisheth the land: but he that receiveth gifts overthroweth it.
verses.decoded: A king who rules fairly brings stability to the nation, but one who accepts bribes destroys it.

verses.kjv: A man that flattereth his neighbour spreadeth a net for his feet.
verses.decoded: Someone who flatters others is actually setting a trap for them.

verses.kjv: In the transgression of an evil man there is a snare: but the righteous doth sing and rejoice.
verses.decoded: The wrongdoing of evil people leads to trouble, but the righteous celebrate with joy.

verses.kjv: The righteous considereth the cause of the poor: but the wicked regardeth not to know it.
verses.decoded: The righteous care about the needs of the poor, but the wicked ignore them.

verses.kjv: Scornful men bring a city into a snare: but wise men turn away wrath.
verses.decoded: Mocking people can cause a city to fall into danger, but wise people calm anger and prevent conflict.

verses.kjv: If a wise man contendeth with a foolish man, whether he rage or laugh, there is no rest.
verses.decoded: When a wise person argues with a fool, no matter if the fool gets angry or laughs, there is no peace.

verses.kjv: The bloodthirsty hate the upright: but the just seek his soul.
verses.decoded: Violent people hate those who live rightly, but the righteous seek to protect themselves.

verses.kjv: A fool uttereth all his mind: but a wise man keepeth it in till afterwards.
verses.decoded: A fool says everything he thinks immediately, but a wise person waits before speaking.

verses.kjv: If a ruler hearken to lies, all his servants are wicked.
verses.decoded: If a leader listens to falsehoods, then everyone under him becomes corrupt.

verses.kjv: The poor and the deceitful man meet together: the LORD lighteneth both their eyes.
verses.decoded: The poor and the dishonest person come together, but the Lord gives insight to both.

verses.kjv: The king that faithfully judgeth the poor, his throne shall be established for ever.
verses.decoded: A king who judges the poor fairly will have a lasting reign.

verses.kjv: The rod and reproof give wisdom: but a child left to himself bringeth his mother to shame.
verses.decoded: Discipline and correction teach wisdom, but a child who is neglected brings shame to their mother.

verses.kjv: When the wicked are multiplied, transgression increaseth: but the righteous shall see their fall.
verses.decoded: When evil people increase, wrongdoing becomes more common; but those who do right will witness their downfall.

verses.kjv: Correct thy son, and he shall give thee rest; yea, he shall give delight unto thy soul.
verses.decoded: Discipline your son, and he will bring you peace and joy.

verses.kjv: Where there is no vision, the people perish: but he that keepeth the law, happy is he.
verses.decoded: Without guidance or vision, people lose their way; but those who follow the law are truly happy.

verses.kjv: A servant will not be corrected by words: for though he understand he will not answer.
verses.decoded: A servant who is stubborn won’t respond to correction, even if he understands it.

verses.kjv: Seest thou a man that is hasty in his words? there is more hope of a fool than of him.
verses.decoded: If you see someone who speaks too quickly without thinking, there’s more hope for a fool than for him.

verses.kjv: He that delicately bringeth up his servant from a child shall have him become his son at the length.
verses.decoded: If you raise a servant carefully from childhood, eventually he will become like a son to you.

verses.kjv: An angry man stirreth up strife, and a furious man aboundeth in transgression.
verses.decoded: An angry person causes conflict, and a furious person commits many wrongs.

verses.kjv: A man’s pride shall bring him low: but honour shall uphold the humble in spirit.
verses.decoded: Pride will bring a person down, but humility brings honor and support.

verses.kjv: Whoso is partner with a thief hateth his own soul: he heareth cursing, and bewrayeth it not.
verses.decoded: Anyone who partners with a thief harms themselves; they hear the curses but don’t speak up.

verses.kjv: The fear of man bringeth a snare: but whoso putteth his trust in the LORD shall be safe.
verses.decoded: Fear of people traps you, but trusting in the LORD keeps you secure.

verses.kjv: Many seek the ruler’s favour; but every man’s judgment cometh from the LORD.
verses.decoded: Many try to gain a leader’s approval, but true judgment belongs to the LORD.

verses.kjv: An unjust man is an abomination to the just: and he that is upright in the way is abomination to the wicked.
verses.decoded: An unfair person is hated by those who are right, and a righteous person is hated by the wicked.

verses.kjv: The words of Agur the son of Jakeh, even the prophecy: the man spake unto Ithiel, even unto Ithiel and Ucal,
verses.decoded: These are the sayings of Agur, son of Jakeh, a prophecy. He spoke to Ithiel, and also to Ithiel and Ucal.

verses.kjv: Surely I am more brutish than any man, and have not the understanding of a man.
verses.decoded: I admit that I am more foolish than anyone else and do not have human understanding.

verses.kjv: I neither learned wisdom, nor have the knowledge of the holy.
verses.decoded: I have not been taught wisdom, nor do I know the knowledge of the Holy One.

verses.kjv: Who hath ascended up into heaven, or descended? who hath gathered the wind in his fists? who hath bound the waters in a garment? who hath established all the ends of the earth? what is his name, and what is his son’s name, if thou canst tell?
verses.decoded: Who has gone up to heaven or come down from there? Who has caught the wind in their hands? Who has wrapped the waters in a cloak? Who has set the boundaries of the earth? Do you know his name or his son's name?

verses.kjv: Every word of God is pure: he is a shield unto them that put their trust in him.
verses.decoded: Every word from God is flawless; he protects those who trust in him.

verses.kjv: Add thou not unto his words, lest he reprove thee, and thou be found a liar.
verses.decoded: Do not add anything to God's words, or he will correct you and you will be proven a liar.

verses.kjv: Two things have I required of thee; deny me them not before I die:
verses.decoded: There are two things I ask from you; do not refuse me before I die.

verses.kjv: Remove far from me vanity and lies: give me neither poverty nor riches; feed me with food convenient for me:
verses.decoded: Keep falsehood and lies away from me. Don’t give me poverty or wealth; just give me enough food to live on.

verses.kjv: Lest I be full, and deny thee, and say, Who is the LORD? or lest I be poor, and steal, and take the name of my God in vain.
verses.decoded: Otherwise, if I become rich, I might deny you and say, 'Who is the Lord?' Or if I become poor, I might steal and dishonor the name of my God.

verses.kjv: Accuse not a servant unto his master, lest he curse thee, and thou be found guilty.
verses.decoded: Don’t accuse a servant to their master, or the servant might curse you and you will be held responsible.

verses.kjv: There is a generation that curseth their father, and doth not bless their mother.
verses.decoded: There is a generation that curses their father and does not bless their mother.

verses.kjv: There is a generation that are pure in their own eyes, and yet is not washed from their filthiness.
verses.decoded: There is a generation that thinks they are pure, but they are still full of corruption.

verses.kjv: There is a generation, O how lofty are their eyes! and their eyelids are lifted up.
verses.decoded: There is a generation whose eyes are proud and arrogant.

verses.kjv: There is a generation, whose teeth are as swords, and their jaw teeth as knives, to devour the poor from off the earth, and the needy from among men.
verses.decoded: There is a generation whose teeth are like swords and their jaws like knives, ready to destroy the poor and needy.

verses.kjv: The horseleach hath two daughters, crying, Give, give. There are three things that are never satisfied, yea, four things say not, It is enough:
verses.decoded: The leech has two daughters that always cry out, 'Give, give!' There are three things that are never satisfied, and a fourth that never says, 'Enough.'

verses.kjv: The grave; and the barren womb; the earth that is not filled with water; and the fire that saith not, It is enough.
verses.decoded: There are four things that are never satisfied: the grave, a barren womb, the earth that is never full of water, and fire that never says, 'Enough.'

verses.kjv: The eye that mocketh at his father, and despiseth to obey his mother, the ravens of the valley shall pick it out, and the young eagles shall eat it.
verses.decoded: The eye that mocks its father and refuses to obey its mother will be pecked out by ravens and eaten by young eagles.

verses.kjv: There be three things which are too wonderful for me, yea, four which I know not:
verses.decoded: There are three things I find too amazing to understand, actually four things I don’t fully grasp:

verses.kjv: The way of an eagle in the air; the way of a serpent upon a rock; the way of a ship in the midst of the sea; and the way of a man with a maid.
verses.decoded: The flight path of an eagle in the sky, the movement of a snake on a rock, the course of a ship through the ocean, and the way a man relates to a woman—these are all mysterious to me.

verses.kjv: Such is the way of an adulterous woman; she eateth, and wipeth her mouth, and saith, I have done no wickedness.
verses.decoded: An adulterous woman behaves like this: she eats, wipes her mouth, and claims she has done nothing wrong.

verses.kjv: For three things the earth is disquieted, and for four which it cannot bear:
verses.decoded: There are three things that disturb the earth, actually four that it cannot tolerate:

verses.kjv: For a servant when he reigneth; and a fool when he is filled with meat;
verses.decoded: A servant who becomes king, and a fool who is full of food—these cause trouble.

verses.kjv: For an odious woman when she is married; and an handmaid that is heir to her mistress.
verses.decoded: An unpleasant woman who is married, and a servant who inherits from her mistress—these also cause unrest.

verses.kjv: There be four things which are little upon the earth, but they are exceeding wise:
verses.decoded: There are four small creatures on earth that are very wise:

verses.kjv: The ants are a people not strong, yet they prepare their meat in the summer;
verses.decoded: Ants are weak but they work hard to gather food during the summer.

verses.kjv: The conies are but a feeble folk, yet make they their houses in the rocks;
verses.decoded: Rock badgers are weak, but they build their homes in the safety of rocks.

verses.kjv: The locusts have no king, yet go they forth all of them by bands;
verses.decoded: Locusts have no leader, yet they move together in large groups.

verses.kjv: The spider taketh hold with her hands, and is in kings’ palaces.
verses.decoded: Spiders catch their prey with their webs and can be found even in royal palaces.

verses.kjv: There be three things which go well, yea, four are comely in going:
verses.decoded: There are three things that move gracefully, actually four that are beautiful in their movement:

verses.kjv: A lion which is strongest among beasts, and turneth not away for any;
verses.decoded: A lion, the strongest of animals, that does not back down from anything;

verses.kjv: A greyhound; an he goat also; and a king, against whom there is no rising up.
verses.decoded: A greyhound, a male goat, and a king—none of these can be opposed or challenged successfully.

verses.kjv: If thou hast done foolishly in lifting up thyself, or if thou hast thought evil, lay thine hand upon thy mouth.
verses.decoded: If you have acted foolishly by being proud or entertained harmful thoughts, be silent and hold your tongue.

verses.kjv: Surely the churning of milk bringeth forth butter, and the wringing of the nose bringeth forth blood: so the forcing of wrath bringeth forth strife.
verses.decoded: Just as churning milk produces butter and squeezing the nose causes bleeding, provoking anger leads to conflict.

verses.kjv: The words of king Lemuel, the prophecy that his mother taught him.
verses.decoded: These are the sayings of King Lemuel, taught to him by his mother.

verses.kjv: What, my son? and what, the son of my womb? and what, the son of my vows?
verses.decoded: What, my son? What, child of my body? What, son of my promises?

verses.kjv: Give not thy strength unto women, nor thy ways to that which destroyeth kings.
verses.decoded: Don’t waste your strength on women or follow paths that ruin kings.

verses.kjv: It is not for kings, O Lemuel, it is not for kings to drink wine; nor for princes strong drink:
verses.decoded: It’s not right for kings, Lemuel, or princes to drink wine or strong liquor.

verses.kjv: Lest they drink, and forget the law, and pervert the judgment of any of the afflicted.
verses.decoded: Because if they drink, they might forget the law and twist justice for the suffering.

verses.kjv: Give strong drink unto him that is ready to perish, and wine unto those that be of heavy hearts.
verses.decoded: Give strong drink to those who are dying and wine to those who are deeply troubled.

verses.kjv: Let him drink, and forget his poverty, and remember his misery no more.
verses.decoded: Let them drink so they forget their poverty and no longer feel their pain.

verses.kjv: Open thy mouth for the dumb in the cause of all such as are appointed to destruction.
verses.decoded: Speak up for those who cannot speak for themselves, for the rights of all who are helpless.

verses.kjv: Open thy mouth, judge righteously, and plead the cause of the poor and needy.
verses.decoded: Speak out, judge fairly, and defend the poor and needy.

verses.kjv: Who can find a virtuous woman? for her price is far above rubies.
verses.decoded: Who can find a woman of noble character? She is worth far more than rubies.

verses.kjv: The heart of her husband doth safely trust in her, so that he shall have no need of spoil.
verses.decoded: Her husband trusts her completely, and he will have no lack of good things.

verses.kjv: She will do him good and not evil all the days of her life.
verses.decoded: She always does him good, never harm, throughout her life.

verses.kjv: She seeketh wool, and flax, and worketh willingly with her hands.
verses.decoded: She looks for wool and flax and works eagerly with her hands.

verses.kjv: She is like the merchants’ ships; she bringeth her food from afar.
verses.decoded: She is like a merchant ship bringing food from far away.

verses.kjv: She riseth also while it is yet night, and giveth meat to her household, and a portion to her maidens.
verses.decoded: She gets up early, before dawn, to prepare food for her family and servants.

verses.kjv: She considereth a field, and buyeth it: with the fruit of her hands she planteth a vineyard.
verses.decoded: She carefully evaluates a piece of land and acquires it; with the work of her hands, she plants a vineyard.

verses.kjv: She girdeth her loins with strength, and strengtheneth her arms.
verses.decoded: She prepares herself with strength and works hard to build her physical endurance.

verses.kjv: She perceiveth that her merchandise is good: her candle goeth not out by night.
verses.decoded: She knows that her business is profitable; she stays up late working by candlelight.

verses.kjv: She layeth her hands to the spindle, and her hands hold the distaff.
verses.decoded: She skillfully works with her hands, spinning thread and weaving.

verses.kjv: She stretcheth out her hand to the poor; yea, she reacheth forth her hands to the needy.
verses.decoded: She generously reaches out to help the poor and extends her hands to those in need.

verses.kjv: She is not afraid of the snow for her household: for all her household are clothed with scarlet.
verses.decoded: She is confident even in winter because her family is well clothed and warm.

verses.kjv: She maketh herself coverings of tapestry; her clothing is silk and purple.
verses.decoded: She makes fine clothes for herself, dressed in luxurious fabrics like silk and purple.

verses.kjv: Her husband is known in the gates, when he sitteth among the elders of the land.
verses.decoded: Her husband is respected and recognized in the community, sitting among the leaders.

verses.kjv: She maketh fine linen, and selleth it; and delivereth girdles unto the merchant.
verses.decoded: She produces fine linen and sells it, supplying belts to merchants.

verses.kjv: Strength and honour are her clothing; and she shall rejoice in time to come.
verses.decoded: She is clothed with strength and dignity, and she looks forward to the future with joy.

verses.kjv: She openeth her mouth with wisdom; and in her tongue is the law of kindness.
verses.decoded: She speaks wisely, and kindness guides everything she says.

verses.kjv: She looketh well to the ways of her household, and eateth not the bread of idleness.
verses.decoded: She carefully manages her household and does not waste time being lazy.

verses.kjv: Her children arise up, and call her blessed; her husband also, and he praiseth her.
verses.decoded: Her children stand and call her blessed, and her husband praises her too.

verses.kjv: Many daughters have done virtuously, but thou excellest them all.
verses.decoded: Many women have done well, but you surpass them all.

verses.kjv: Favour is deceitful, and beauty is vain: but a woman that feareth the LORD, she shall be praised.
verses.decoded: Charm can be misleading and beauty fades, but a woman who respects the Lord deserves praise.

verses.kjv: Give her of the fruit of her hands; and let her own works praise her in the gates.
verses.decoded: Reward her for all the hard work she has done, and let her accomplishments be recognized publicly.
